66415.recognize_zh: 組織 Gram 染色中，一大塊紫紅色、邊緣模糊的絨毛狀／點狀陽性菌落團塊，位於黃褐色背景與發炎細胞之間；雖然個別絲狀菌解析不清，這種成團的 Gram 陽性絨毛狀物質對應放線菌硫磺顆粒。
features: Large irregular purple-magenta mass with fuzzy, finely granular/dot-like Gram-positive staining
Individual branching filaments are not well resolved; staining is patchy with a feathery edge
Yellow-brown counterstained background with red cells and fibrin surrounding the colony
Numerous inflammatory cells with red-stained nuclei (predominantly neutrophils) at the periphery
Clear slit-like spaces within the granule
66415.describe_en: Tissue Gram stain of the peritoneal nodule shows a large irregular colony that stains purple-magenta with a fuzzy, finely granular and dot-like pattern of Gram positivity. Individual branching filaments are not clearly resolved, reflecting suboptimal staining quality. The colony is surrounded by yellow-brown counterstained red cells and fibrin and by an inflammatory infiltrate composed predominantly of neutrophils. In correlation with the H&E sulfur granule, findings are consistent with a colony of Gram-positive filamentous bacteria of actinomycosis.

ddx.vs: Nocardia also forms Gram-positive beaded branching filaments but is positive on modified acid-fast (Fite) stain, whereas Actinomyces is acid-fast negative.
Tissue Gram stain resolves discrete cocci or bacilli within the granule rather than a fuzzy filamentous mass.
Fungal grains contain broad septate hyphae that stain strongly with GMS/PAS and are not composed of thin Gram-positive filaments.
Precipitate is non-cellular and lies over background and cells alike, without a discrete colony bordered by neutrophils.

66223.recognize_zh: 這是九格流式細胞儀散布圖：CD45 強陽性、低側向散射的淋巴球閘中約 80% 為 CD19+ B 細胞（紅色），CD79b、CD22 陽性，CD23 陰性、CD200 陰性至弱，CD43 部分陽性；CD5 未顯示，此 CD23−/CD200 低的成熟 B 細胞表型支持脾邊緣區淋巴瘤而非 CLL。
features: Gating: CD45 vs FSC and CD45 vs SSC identify a bright CD45, low SSC lymphocyte gate (58.6% of events)
CD19-positive B cells (red) comprise 79.6% of the gated lymphocytes
B cells are CD79b positive and CD22 positive
CD23 negative (Q2-UR 0.95%) and CD200 negative to dim
CD43 partially positive on B cells (Q1-UR 62.7% versus Q1-LR 17.5%), with T cells (green) serving as the CD43-positive internal control
66223.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows a predominant population of CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphocytes, of which approximately 80% are CD19-positive B cells. The B cells express CD79b and CD22, partially express CD43, and are negative for CD23 and negative to dim for CD200. Light chain restriction and CD5, CD10 and CD11c status are not shown in this panel and are required to confirm clonality and complete the classification. In the context of splenomegaly and villous lymphocytes, this CD23-negative, CD200-low mature B-cell phenotype is compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma, although CD43 expression is relatively uncommon in this entity.

ddx.vs: CLL is CD5+, CD23+ and CD200 bright with dim CD79b, CD22 and surface light chain, the opposite of the CD23-negative, CD79b-bright population here.
MCL is typically CD5+ and CD200 negative like this case but carries cyclin D1/t(11;14), so CD5 and cyclin D1 or FISH are needed.
HCL is CD11c bright, CD25+, CD103+, CD123+ and CD200 bright, whereas this population is CD200 negative to dim.
LPL shows a similar CD5-/CD23- B-cell phenotype but with a clonal plasma cell component, IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

66159.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽取抹片中央一顆巨大細胞，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色並有細密纖維狀條紋，像皺摺的衛生紙（wrinkled tissue paper），這是 Gaucher 細胞；細胞本身的核在此圖不易辨認，其上重疊的粉紅色核應為其他造血細胞。
features: Very large cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm showing fine fibrillary, striated texture (wrinkled tissue paper or crumpled silk appearance)
The cell's own nucleus is not clearly discernible; nuclei overlying the cytoplasm appear to belong to superimposed hematopoietic cells
No discrete vacuoles or ingested cells within the cytoplasm
Background of mixed granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Red cells show a gray-green tint consistent with a staining artifact
66159.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed granulocytic and erythroid precursors with a staining artifact imparting a gray-green tint to red cells. A very large histiocytic cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm displaying a fine fibrillary, wrinkled tissue paper texture is present; its nucleus is not clearly delineated, with overlying hematopoietic cells superimposed on the cytoplasm. No soap-bubble vacuolation, hemophagocytosis or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell, and confirmation by glucocerebrosidase activity or GBA1 testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cell (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look nearly identical but occur with an underlying neoplasm or infection and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Niemann-Pick cell (sea-blue histiocyte or foam cell)
ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick cells have uniform soap-bubble vacuoles or sea-blue granules rather than fibrillary striated cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a lobulated nucleus and finely granular lilac cytoplasm without striations.
Hemophagocytes contain engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells within vacuoles rather than homogeneous striated cytoplasm.

65647.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在多顆大型非典型單核細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色，核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、可見核仁，與旁邊的小淋巴球大小差距明顯；背景另見含空泡的組織球，型態上像免疫母細胞或大型異常淋巴細胞，需靠 EBV 染色與免疫組化分類。
features: Large atypical mononuclear cells, several times the size of small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Round, oval to indented/irregular nuclei with fine to vesicular chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm without granules, some with cytoplasmic tails
Several smudged/disrupted cells with open reticular chromatin
Vacuolated histiocytes, one containing ingested debris; scattered small lymphocytes and a neutrophil
Hemodilute background with abundant red cells
65647.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hemodilute and contains scattered large atypical mononuclear cells with abundant gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei, fine to vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli. Several cells are disrupted, and vacuolated histiocytes, one containing ingested debris, are present among small lymphocytes. No blasts with granules or Auer rods are identified. The atypical cells are immunoblast-like and not lineage-specific on morphology; with reported EBV positivity and scattered CD30 expression, findings raise concern for an EBV-associated lymphoproliferative disorder, and tissue biopsy with lineage markers is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Blasts have high N:C ratio and finer chromatin with scant cytoplasm and would be CD34/TdT/CD117 positive, whereas these cells are negative for those markers.
HLH shows many histiocytes engulfing intact hematopoietic cells, whereas this field is dominated by large atypical lymphoid-appearing cells with only occasional debris-laden histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or classic Hodgkin lymphoma involvement
ddx.vs: ALCL has hallmark horseshoe nuclei with strong uniform CD30 (and ALK in children), and HRS cells are CD15/CD30 positive in a mixed background; here CD30 is only scattered and ALK is negative.

Reactive immunoblasts occur in a polymorphous spectrum with plasmacytoid forms and resolve clinically, whereas persistent cytopenias, hepatosplenomegaly and marrow infiltration favor a lymphoproliferative disorder.

65903.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎被漿細胞佔滿，形成片狀：核圓偏位、染色質粗塊、細胞質豐富灰藍並有核旁淡染區；右上方可見多核漿細胞群，部分細胞偏大、較不成熟，強烈提示漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Sheets of plasma cells replacing the field with loss of normal hematopoietic elements
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin; occasional small nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleate and multinucleate plasma cells (upper right cluster)
Variation in cell size with some larger immature forms; occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Image slightly out of focus
65903.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of plasma cells that largely replace normal hematopoietic elements in this field. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, perinuclear hofs and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, with variation in size, some immature forms and occasional binucleate or multinucleate cells. Focus is slightly suboptimal. Findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell myeloma; the plasma cell percentage should be quantified and clonality confirmed by flow cytometry or κ/λ studies, correlated with M-protein and CRAB/SLiM criteria.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells rarely exceed 10–20%, are mature and polytypic, and do not form sheets with multinucleated atypical forms.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows larger cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli, often EBER-positive, rather than predominantly mature-appearing plasma cells.
LPL shows mixed small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 mutation.

65455.recognize_zh: 高倍血片可見大量盔形細胞（helmet cell）、三角形與不規則的紅血球碎片（schistocyte），血小板極少，是微血管病變性溶血（MAHA）的典型血片。
features: Numerous schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular and irregular red cell fragments
Scattered small dense microspherocytic fragments
Marked anisopoikilocytosis at low power
Markedly decreased platelets
No nucleated red cells or blasts in the fields shown; a single neutrophil at low power
65455.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with conspicuous red cell fragmentation. At high power there are numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells and triangular fragments, with scattered microspherocytic forms. Platelets are markedly decreased, and no leukoerythroblastic features or blasts are seen in the fields shown. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia; in this clinical context (pancreatitis, normal ADAMTS13, negative Coombs), pancreatitis-associated MAHA-T is favored.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so TTP is separated by severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity (<10%), which was 91% here.
Also morphologically identical; distinguished by stool Shiga toxin/E. coli testing and complement functional or genetic studies, both negative in this case.
DIC shows schistocytes with prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, which require coagulation testing rather than smear morphology.
These show round spherocytes without helmet cells or angular fragments, and immune hemolysis has a positive direct Coombs test.

64879.recognize_zh: 這不是形態圖，而是 14 張依住院日排列的紅血球體積直方圖：HD#3–4 峰的左側有小紅血球（碎裂紅血球）拖尾，HD#10 起右側出現明顯的大細胞「肩峰」（網狀紅血球），之後整個分布變寬，反映 TTP 溶血與骨髓代償的過程。
features: Series of 14 impedance RBC volume histograms labeled by hospital day (HD #3 to HD #18)
Early curves (HD #3-4) show a left-sided microcytic tail consistent with schistocytes
A right-sided macrocytic shoulder appears by about HD #5-7 and becomes prominent at HD #10-13
Later curves (HD #14-18) are broadened and right-shifted, reflecting increased RDW and MCV
Vertical solid and dotted gates mark the population percentile limits and 60/120 fL thresholds
64879.describe_en: This figure shows serial impedance red cell volume histograms from a patient with TTP rather than a morphologic image. Early histograms show a single peak with a left-sided microcytic tail, consistent with circulating schistocytes and red cell fragments. From about hospital day 5 a right-sided macrocytic shoulder emerges and becomes prominent by day 10, reflecting reticulocytosis during recovery from hemolysis, and the distribution progressively broadens. These changes correspond to rising RDW and MCV and indicate that the histogram can track fragmentation and marrow response in TTP.

65135.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央的嗜中性白血球，在核葉右上方的細胞質中有一顆小而圓、與細胞核同樣深紫色、邊界清楚的包涵物，與核葉分離且無核絲相連，形態類似 Howell-Jolly body。
features: Neutrophil with a single small, round, dense dark purple inclusion adjacent to but separate from the nuclear lobes
Inclusion homogeneous and chromatin-like, without a connecting nuclear filament
Host neutrophil has 3 nuclear lobes and fine pink granular cytoplasm
No toxic granulation, Dohle bodies or vacuolation
Background crenated red cells (likely artifact) and scattered platelets
65135.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a trilobed nucleus and pale pink granular cytoplasm containing a single small, round, sharply circumscribed dark purple inclusion adjacent to the nuclear lobes, without a visible chromatin filament connecting it to the nucleus. No toxic granulation, Dohle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles are seen. The background shows crenated red cells and adequate platelets. Findings are consistent with a Howell-Jolly body-like inclusion in a neutrophil, a finding reported with immunosuppressive therapy (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus), chemotherapy and HIV infection.

ddx.dx: Small nuclear lobe or drumstick (Barr body)
ddx.vs: A drumstick is attached to a nuclear lobe by a fine chromatin strand, whereas this inclusion lies free in the cytoplasm.
Platelets show granular centers with a pale hyalomere and often sit at the cell margin in a different focal plane, unlike this homogeneous dense sphere.
Dohle bodies are pale blue-grey irregular peripheral patches rather than a dark purple round dot.

65071.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現許多循環中的漿細胞樣細胞：細胞核偏心、細胞質嗜鹼性並有核旁淡染區，部分體積較大、染色質較開放並可見核仁，或有細胞質突起，屬漿母細胞／不成熟漿細胞，另見破碎的塗抹細胞。
features: Circulating plasmacytoid cells in peripheral blood, singly and in small clusters
Eccentric round nuclei with clock-face to more open chromatin; some with visible nucleoli (plasmablastic)
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof and occasional cytoplasmic blebs or tails
Variation in cell size, with larger immature forms alongside more mature plasma cells
Smudged, disrupted cells in the upper left panel; red cells without obvious rouleaux in these fields
65071.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of several fields) shows numerous circulating plasma cells, singly and in small clusters. The cells have eccentric round nuclei, moderate basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs and occasional cytoplasmic blebs; many are enlarged with more open chromatin and discernible nucleoli, consistent with plasmablasts or immature plasma cells. Smudged, disrupted cells are also present. Findings indicate circulating neoplastic plasma cells in a plasma cell dyscrasia; if circulating plasma cells are 5% or more of leukocytes, the criteria for plasma cell leukemia are met, and flow cytometry (CD38/CD138 positive, CD19/CD45 negative or dim, cytoplasmic light chain restriction) should confirm clonality.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis in blood (e.g., viral infection, sepsis)
ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, small and mature, accompanied by reactive lymphocytes, and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma / Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD19/CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P, rather than predominantly immature plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger immunoblasts with prominent central nucleoli, commonly EBV positive and MYC rearranged, usually arising at extranodal sites in immunocompromised patients.

64943.recognize_zh: 視野內許多紅血球呈緻密、無中央淡染區，周圍有少數長短不一、分布不規則的棘刺（acanthocyte）；右下方有一顆雙至三葉核、胞質充滿顆粒的嗜酸性球（eosinophil）作為大小對照。
features: Many dense red cells without central pallor bearing few irregular spicules of uneven length (acanthocytes)
Some red cells with finer, more regular crenation (echinocyte-like) and occasional elongated forms
One eosinophil with lobulated nucleus and cytoplasm packed with refractile granules
Background normocytic red cells with central pallor
Scattered normal platelets
64943.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (oil immersion) shows numerous acanthocytes, recognized as contracted, dense red cells lacking central pallor with a few irregular, unevenly spaced spicules. Occasional more regularly crenated cells are admixed. A single eosinophil with a lobulated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm is present, and platelets appear normal. Findings are consistent with acanthocytosis; the eosinophil is an incidental finding.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes carry many short, uniform, evenly spaced projections and keep their central pallor, unlike the few irregular spicules on dense acanthocytes.
Spherocytes are small and dense without pallor but have a smooth, round outline with no spicules.
Schistocytes are fragments with sharp angles or straight edges from mechanical injury rather than whole cells with multiple spicules.

64431.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片低倍下散布細長針狀、淡藍色的細胞外結晶（黃色箭頭），高倍可見結晶旁有許多漿細胞（偏心核、核周淡染區、嗜鹼性細胞質）；λ 免疫染色在結晶周邊著色，提示單株免疫球蛋白結晶沉積。
features: Low-power aspirate smear with scattered extracellular needle- or rod-shaped crystals (arrows) among cellular marrow particles
Crystals are elongated, pale blue to clear, refractile and of variable length, lying free between cells (panel B)
Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
Panel C: lambda IHC shows peripheral staining of a rod-shaped crystal on the biopsy, with lambda-positive plasma cells nearby
64431.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cellular particles with an increase in plasma cells, which display eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing, admixed with maturing hematopoietic elements. Numerous extracellular, elongated needle- to rod-shaped pale blue crystals of variable length are present between cells. On the core biopsy, lambda immunostain decorates the periphery of a rod-shaped crystal and highlights adjacent plasma cells. With 27% clonal lambda-restricted plasma cells and an IgG-lambda paraprotein, findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (smoldering multiple myeloma) with extracellular crystalline immunoglobulin deposition.

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are needle-shaped and strongly negatively birefringent under polarized light, dissolve in aqueous fixation, and do not stain for immunoglobulin light chains.
In crystal-storing histiocytosis the crystals are intracellular within CD68+/CD163+ histiocytes rather than lying free in the extracellular space.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal/hexagonal and associated with abundant eosinophils, not with light chain-restricted plasma cells.
Contaminants lie in a different focal plane over cells, are uniform and non-biological, and do not show light-chain immunoreactivity on tissue sections.

64367.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒中成片的大型細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍紫色、帶細纖維狀皺紙紋理，核小而圓、偏心，細胞邊界融合成片，符合 Gaucher 細胞聚集。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant pale blue-lilac cytoplasm and merging cell borders
Fine fibrillary, wrinkled tissue paper cytoplasmic texture
Small round to oval nuclei with coarse chromatin, eccentrically placed, one or two per cell
Scattered small dark hematopoietic cells and fat spaces within the particle
Occasional fine dark cytoplasmic granules/debris
64367.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marrow particle largely replaced by sheets of large histiocytes. These cells have small, round, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and abundant pale blue-lilac cytoplasm with a fibrillary crumpled tissue paper texture, with residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces interspersed. Foamy vacuolation and discrete sea-blue granules are absent. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells, to be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity or GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma, thalassemia or mycobacterial infection are morphologically similar, and are excluded by normal glucocerebrosidase activity and absence of such a disorder.
Niemann-Pick cells show uniform soap-bubble vacuolation rather than fibrillary striations.
Histiocytes filled with atypical mycobacteria show negative-image rods and are acid-fast positive.

64047.recognize_zh: CD45 免疫染色中，左側胞質豐富、泡狀核的大型異型細胞與右側小淋巴球都呈棕色細胞膜染色，證實大細胞為造血淋巴來源而非上皮癌。
features: Membranous and cytoplasmic brown CD45 staining of large atypical cells with abundant cytoplasm (left)
Strong crisp membranous staining of background small lymphocytes (right)
Large cells have vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli on hematoxylin counterstain
No CD45-negative cohesive epithelial nests identified in this field
64047.describe_en: CD45 (leukocyte common antigen) immunohistochemistry shows diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic staining of the large atypical cells, which have vesicular nuclei and abundant cytoplasm. Background small lymphocytes are strongly positive and serve as an internal positive control. No CD45-negative tumor population is identified in this field. The staining supports a hematolymphoid origin of the large atypical cells, favoring large cell lymphoma over carcinoma or melanoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are CD45 negative with the positive staining confined to intervening lymphocytes, whereas here the large cells themselves are CD45 positive.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are characteristically CD45 negative with surrounding CD45+ rosetting T cells.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: These are often CD45 weak/negative and PAX5 negative with CD138/MUM1 expression, unlike this diffusely CD45+ PAX5+ population.

63919.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅系前驅細胞明顯增多，許多細胞質深藍、核圓而染色質細顆粒狀的早期紅血球母細胞，部分核輪廓不規則或呈芽狀；另見偏左移的顆粒球系與顆粒稀少的細胞，兩系以上都有發育異常，符合多系發育異常的 MDS。
features: Hypercellular smear with markedly increased erythroid precursors, many at the proerythroblast and basophilic erythroblast stages with deep blue cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with finely granular chromatin, some showing irregular nuclear contours or lobulation
Left-shifted granulopoiesis with promyelocytes and myelocytes containing pink-purple granules
Occasional granulocytic cells with reduced granulation and a cell with a lobulated, clumped nucleus
Background red cells and smeared cells; blasts are not obviously increased in this field
63919.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows marked erythroid hyperplasia composed largely of proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts with deep blue cytoplasm and finely granular chromatin, several of which have irregular or lobulated nuclear contours. Granulopoiesis is left shifted, with promyelocytes and myelocytes, and occasional granulocytic cells show reduced cytoplasmic granulation. Blasts do not appear increased in this field, although an accurate count requires a full differential. Findings show dyserythropoiesis with granulocytic dysplasia and are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with multilineage dysplasia, provided blast percentage, ring sideroblasts and cytogenetics are assessed and reactive causes such as B12 or folate deficiency are excluded.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows open sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and it corrects with vitamin replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires more than 80% erythroid precursors with at least 30% proerythroblasts, typically with TP53 mutation, rather than maturing erythroid hyperplasia.

ddx.dx: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia (hemolysis or blood loss recovery)
ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation to orthochromatic normoblasts without nuclear irregularity or granulocytic hypogranulation.
AML-MR requires blasts at or above 20% (or the defined threshold) on a 500-cell differential, which morphology in a single field cannot establish.

63791.recognize_zh: 藍色複染背景中散布大量細長、略彎曲、帶串珠狀的洋紅色桿菌，抗酸染色（Ziehl-Neelsen）陽性，代表肉芽腫內有大量抗酸桿菌（AFB），提示分枝桿菌感染。
features: Numerous slender, long, slightly curved magenta-red bacilli (acid-fast positive)
Some bacilli beaded, scattered singly and in small loose clusters
Bacilli located among histiocyte nuclei in a blue methylene blue counterstained background
Occasional bacilli appear within cytoplasm of histiocytes
High organism burden in this field
63791.describe_en: Ziehl-Neelsen stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows numerous slender, long, slightly curved and beaded magenta acid-fast bacilli dispersed among histiocytes against a blue counterstained background. The organism burden is high. Findings are consistent with mycobacterial infection involving the bone marrow; culture and molecular testing are required to distinguish Mycobacterium tuberculosis from nontuberculous mycobacteria such as M. avium complex, and a high bacillary load should prompt evaluation for immunodeficiency.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterium avium complex in immunocompromised host
ddx.vs: Typically shows sheets of histiocytes stuffed with innumerable short bacilli and poorly formed granulomas; speciation requires culture or PCR.
Branching filamentous organisms that are only weakly (modified) acid-fast, unlike the non-branching bacilli here.
Weakly acid-fast on Fite stain with clinical skin and nerve involvement, rarely presenting as marrow disease.
Artifacts vary in thickness, lie outside the focal plane of cells, and lack the uniform rod shape and beading of bacilli.

63663.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞圖：CD19/CD20 強陽性的 B 細胞群（藍色）幾乎全為 lambda 輕鏈（97.6%），並表現 CD200、弱 CD25 與部分 CD103，CD123 陰性，代表單株 B 細胞族群；少數 kappa 陽性細胞（紅色）為殘存的正常 B 細胞。
features: CD19 vs CD20: B-cell population with bright CD20 (blue) plus a smaller, dimmer population (red)
Kappa vs lambda of gated B cells: 97.6% lambda (blue) versus 1.9% kappa (red), indicating lambda restriction
Lambda-restricted cells show variable (partial) CD103 and positive CD200
Lambda-restricted cells weakly positive for CD25 and negative for CD123
Kappa-positive red events largely lack CD103 and CD25 and have dimmer CD200 (residual normal B cells)
63663.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots show a dominant CD19-positive B-cell population with bright CD20 that is lambda light chain restricted (97.6% lambda versus 1.9% kappa). The clonal population (blue) shows variable CD103, positive CD200, and weak CD25, and lacks CD123; the few kappa-positive events (red) are CD103 and CD25 negative, consistent with residual polyclonal B cells. CD5 and CD10 were reported negative. Bright CD20 with CD25, CD200, and CD103 expression supports hairy cell leukemia, although the variable CD103 and absent CD123 are atypical and warrant correlation with annexin A1 immunohistochemistry and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: HCL variant is CD103 positive but CD25, CD123, and annexin A1 negative and BRAF wild type.
SMZL is usually CD103 negative, CD123 negative, and CD200 dim or negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL is typically CD25 and CD103 negative and annexin A1 negative.
CLL is CD5 and CD23 positive with dim CD20 and lacks CD103 and CD25.

63599.recognize_zh: 高倍切片中，箭頭處細胞核上方有圓形、淡粉紅色、邊界清楚的核內假包涵體（Dutcher body），背景是小淋巴球、漿細胞樣淋巴球混合的細胞群，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的典型線索。
features: Two cells with round, pale eosinophilic (PAS-positive type) intranuclear pseudoinclusions (Dutcher bodies) surrounded by a rim of dark chromatin
Background of densely packed small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and clumped chromatin
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Scattered small clear cytoplasmic spaces; no large transformed cells or sheets of blasts
Rare extravasated red cells
63599.describe_en: High-power H&E sections show a dense infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells. Two cells contain well-circumscribed, pale eosinophilic intranuclear pseudoinclusions consistent with Dutcher bodies. Large transformed cells are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context (IgM paraprotein, MYD88 L265P).

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies can also occur in MZL, so separation relies on marginal zone/monocytoid cell morphology, clinical site, and the absence of MYD88 L265P.
Myeloma consists of sheets of plasma cells without a clonal small B-lymphocyte component and usually shows CD56 expression and a non-IgM paraprotein.
Reactive infiltrates are polytypic for kappa/lambda and Dutcher bodies are rare, whereas LPL shows light-chain-restricted B cells and plasma cells.

63535.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現一顆胞質豐富、淡灰藍帶細小顆粒與空泡、邊界不規則，細胞核雙葉或折疊的大細胞；在系統性肥大細胞增生症病人中可代表低顆粒的非典型肥大細胞，但這張圖的顆粒稀少，形態上難與單核球區分，需 tryptase/CD117 確認。
features: Single large cell with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm and irregular, angulated borders molded by red cells
Bilobed/folded nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin, eccentric in position
Cytoplasm shows fine vacuolation and sparse faint granules; dense metachromatic granules are not evident
Background of normocytic red cells with scattered platelets; no other leukocytes in the field
Hypogranular appearance limits morphologic distinction from a monocyte
63535.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large cell with abundant pale grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing sparse faint granules, irregular angulated borders and an eccentric bilobed to folded nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin. The background red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. The cell lacks the dense metachromatic granulation of a typical mast cell, and on morphology alone a monocyte cannot be excluded. In a patient with systemic mastocytosis, this may represent a circulating hypogranular atypical (bilobed) mast cell; confirmation by tryptase or CD117/CD25 flow cytometry is recommended, and quantification is needed to assess for mast cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic dust and a folded nucleus with lacy chromatin, and are CD14+ and tryptase negative, which may be required to separate them from hypogranular mast cells.
Basophils are smaller with coarse dark granules that overlie and obscure a lobulated nucleus, whereas mast cells are larger with abundant cytoplasm and a round to bilobed nucleus.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections and oval nuclei and are CD20+, CD103+ B cells without granules.

63343.recognize_zh: 一個比一般小淋巴球稍大的淋巴球，核圓、染色質塊狀，胞質量中等偏淡藍，裡面有散在的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），這就是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Lymphocyte slightly larger than a small lymphocyte (about 1.5x red cell)
Round nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, eccentrically placed
Fine to coarse azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Background normochromic red cells
63343.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature lymphocyte with a round nucleus, condensed chromatin and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered fine to coarse azurophilic granules. No nucleoli or atypical nuclear features are seen. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte (cytotoxic T cell or NK cell); a persistent increase would warrant flow cytometry to evaluate T-LGL leukemia or chronic NK lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Small lymphocytes have only a scant rim of agranular cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and shows peripheral basophilia, usually without discrete granules.
Promyelocytes have fine chromatin with nucleoli and many granules, and monocytes have folded nuclei with gray vacuolated cytoplasm.

63279.recognize_zh: EBUS-TBNA 淋巴結抹片在出血背景中，出現與淋巴球不同、黏合成團且核重疊的上皮樣細胞群（1a），以及排成小團、局部呈微濾泡狀的圓核細胞（1b）；淋巴結內出現外來的黏合性細胞團，就該想到轉移癌，濾泡樣排列則提示甲狀腺來源。
features: Composite of two panels (Figure 1a, 1b) of EBUS-TBNA smears with a heavily hemorrhagic background
Figure 1a: large cohesive, crowded cluster of cells with overlapping oval nuclei and syncytial arrangement
Figure 1b: small cohesive clusters of cells with uniform round to oval nuclei, focally forming microfollicle-like groups
Cells are larger than and cohere unlike background lymphocytes; moderate pale cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Nuclear grooves are not reliably resolved at this magnification and image quality
63279.describe_en: EBUS-guided transbronchial needle aspirate smears from a hilar lymph node show a hemorrhagic background containing cohesive clusters of atypical epithelial cells foreign to lymph node. One panel shows a crowded aggregate with nuclear overlapping, while the other shows smaller groups of cells with round to oval nuclei focally arranged in microfollicular structures. Fine nuclear details such as grooves and pseudoinclusions cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. The findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; the follicular arrangement supports a thyroid primary, which should be confirmed with thyroglobulin/TTF-1 immunocytochemistry on a cell block.

ddx.vs: Also forms cohesive clusters in hilar nodes but typically shows 3-D acinar/papillary groups with prominent nucleoli and is TTF-1 positive but thyroglobulin and PAX8 negative.
Benign bronchial cells from the needle track form flat honeycomb or columnar strips with cilia and terminal bars, lacking nuclear overlap and follicle formation.
Shows loosely cohesive small cells with scant cytoplasm, nuclear molding, salt-and-pepper chromatin and crush artifact rather than follicles.
Epithelioid histiocyte clusters have elongated, footprint-shaped nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm, without follicular architecture.

63087.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量早幼粒球、骨髓球等未成熟顆粒球，核內染色質聚集成粗大塊狀（abnormal chromatin clumping），細胞質顆粒減少、呈淡灰藍色；這種異常染色質凝集是 aCML 變異型的特殊形態。
features: Predominance of immature granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes, myelocytes) with left shift
Nuclei with coarse, block-like clumps of chromatin separated by clear spaces
Hypogranular, pale gray-blue cytoplasm in precursors
Occasional larger immature cell with a more open chromatin pattern
Scattered orthochromatic normoblasts and lymphocytes; fibrin strands in background; platelets scarce
63087.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a granulocytic proliferation with a left shift, dominated by promyelocytes and myelocytes whose nuclei contain coarse, block-like clumps of chromatin. The cytoplasm of these precursors is hypogranular. Scattered normoblasts are present and platelets are scarce. In a patient with leukocytosis, anemia and thrombocytopenia, the dysgranulopoiesis with abnormal chromatin clumping is suggestive of the syndrome of abnormal chromatin clumping, a variant of atypical CML (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia); exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and assessment of blasts are required.

ddx.vs: CML shows basophilia and orderly granulocytic maturation without marked dysgranulopoiesis or chromatin clumping, and is BCR::ABL1-positive.
CMML requires persistent monocytosis (>=0.5 x10^9/L and >=10% of leukocytes).
AML requires increased blasts (typically >=20%), whereas this field is dominated by maturing precursors rather than blasts.
Reactive granulopoiesis shows hypergranular, toxic granules without hypogranularity or bizarre chromatin clumping.

62895.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量低、脂肪多，間質中散布一片片小型單核細胞，核圓到腎形、周圍有透明淡染的細胞質使細胞彼此間距寬（煎蛋樣 fried-egg），夾雜成群的紅系前驅細胞，是毛細胞白血病的間質性浸潤型態。
features: Hypocellular, fat-predominant marrow for age
Interstitial infiltrate of small to medium mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and abundant clear to pale cytoplasm, giving widely spaced 'fried-egg' appearance
Loose, delicate eosinophilic stroma between the infiltrating cells
Discrete clusters of erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei interspersed
Occasional megakaryocyte; no nodular or paratrabecular lymphoid aggregates
62895.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypocellular for age with abundant fat. The interstitium contains a subtle infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm, producing a widely spaced 'fried-egg' pattern within a delicate, slightly edematous stroma. Clusters of erythroid precursors and occasional megakaryocytes are present, but granulopoiesis appears reduced. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia with interstitial involvement, which is supported by CD20 and cyclin D1 positivity; reticulin fibrosis explains a frequent dry tap.

ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow is fatty without a clear-cell interstitial lymphoid infiltrate, and hypocellular MDS shows dysplasia without CD20+ annexin A1+ cells.
Mast cells form spindle-cell paratrabecular/perivascular aggregates with eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive, not CD20 positive.
SMZL forms nodular and intrasinusoidal aggregates and lacks annexin A1, CD25, CD103 and BRAF V600E.
Gelatinous transformation shows amorphous pale extracellular material with atrophic fat, without an interstitial cellular infiltrate.

62959.recognize_zh: BCL2 染色下幾乎所有腫瘤細胞呈強而一致的細胞膜/細胞質棕色陽性，只有散在的組織球與內皮細胞為藍色陰性；被套細胞淋巴瘤通常 BCL2 陽性，但這個標記本身沒有鑑別特異性。
features: Strong diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic BCL2 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Perinuclear ring-like accentuation around round nuclei
Scattered negative cells with elongated or oval nuclei (endothelial cells, histiocytes)
Dense sheet-like growth of intermediate-sized cells
62959.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for BCL2 shows strong, diffuse cytoplasmic and membranous staining in nearly all neoplastic lymphoid cells, with only scattered negative stromal cells and histiocytes. BCL2 expression is expected in mantle cell lymphoma and most low-grade B-cell lymphomas and does not by itself establish the subtype. Interpretation requires cyclin D1, SOX11, and CD5 results, which support mantle cell lymphoma in this case.

ddx.vs: FL is also BCL2+ but shows follicular architecture with CD10+/BCL6+ cells and is cyclin D1- and CD5-.
CLL/SLL is BCL2+ and CD5+ but is LEF1+ and cyclin D1-, with proliferation centers on H&E.
Reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative with a polarized, non-monotonous population, unlike diffuse BCL2+ sheets.

62831.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中箭頭所指的紅血球內含深染、兩端平直的長方形棒狀結晶（Hb C crystals），周圍還有許多靶形紅血球（target cells，星號）；「結晶＋大量靶形細胞」是血紅素 C 病的典型組合。
features: Several dense, homogeneous, rectangular/bar-shaped Hb C crystals with parallel sides and blunt ends, within red cell membranes (arrows)
Some crystals leave a pale empty remnant of the red cell membrane adjacent to the crystal
Numerous target cells with central hemoglobinized 'bull's-eye' (stars)
Occasional folded cells and dense spherocyte-like red cells
Scattered platelets; no sickle cells seen in this field
62831.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells and several red cells containing dense, homogeneous, rectangular intracellular crystals with parallel sides and blunt ends, some displacing the remaining hemoglobin to leave a pale membrane remnant. Occasional folded and hyperdense red cells are present, and platelets appear adequate. No classic sickle cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C disease; hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required to distinguish Hb CC from Hb SC.

ddx.vs: Hb SC also shows crystals and target cells but characteristically has irregular 'Washington monument' or glove-shaped SC crystals and occasional sickle forms; electrophoresis confirms.
Hb SS shows elongated, pointed-ended sickle cells rather than straight-sided rectangular crystals within intact membranes.

ddx.dx: Target cells from liver disease or thalassemia
ddx.vs: These show target cells but no intraerythrocytic hemoglobin crystals.

ddx.dx: Artifactual overlapping red cells or stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Overlapping cells show two superimposed circular outlines, whereas Hb C crystals are sharp-edged rectangles within a single cell outline.

62767.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見體積大、顆粒缺乏而呈淡灰藍色的血小板（虛線箭頭）；骨髓巨核細胞胞質內包著多顆完整的中性球等細胞（emperipolesis，實線箭頭），免疫染色中巨核細胞內也有多個被包入的細胞，符合灰色血小板症候群。
features: Peripheral blood: enlarged platelets that are pale gray-blue and agranular (dotted arrows)
Marrow megakaryocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm containing multiple intact neutrophils and other hematopoietic cells (emperipolesis)
H&E sections show megakaryocytes with engulfed cells within cytoplasm (arrows)
Megakaryocyte immunostain outlines the cytoplasm with multiple unstained engulfed cells inside
Additional immunostains highlight engulfed and surrounding myeloid cells (antibodies not labeled in the image)
62767.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows reduced platelets, several of which are large, pale gray-blue, and devoid of granules. The bone marrow aspirate shows megakaryocytes containing numerous intact neutrophils and other hematopoietic cells within their cytoplasm, a finding that is also evident on H&E-stained biopsy sections. Immunohistochemistry outlines megakaryocyte cytoplasm with multiple engulfed unstained cells, and a second stain highlights engulfed myeloid cells; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the image. Findings are consistent with gray platelet syndrome with striking megakaryocytic emperipolesis; confirmation by electron microscopy for absent alpha granules or NBEAL2 sequencing is recommended.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show large but normally granulated platelets and Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils, rather than gray agranular platelets.
PMF also shows increased emperipolesis but with clustered atypical megakaryocytes, reticulin fibrosis, and a JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, while platelets retain granules.

ddx.dx: In vitro degranulation artifact (EDTA or delayed processing)
ddx.vs: Artifactual hypogranular platelets are normal-sized and variable and resolve on a citrate or fresh finger-stick smear.
MDS shows dysplastic hypolobated micromegakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia in an older patient, not an inherited lifelong macrothrombocytopenia.

62703.recognize_zh: 這是一張分類表而非形態圖：列出 WHO 2016 EBV 陽性 T/NK 細胞增生性疾病與好發年齡；前五項（EBV-HLH、全身性 CAEBV、水痘樣皰疹樣 LPD、嚴重蚊蟲叮咬過敏、全身性 EBV+ T 細胞淋巴瘤）好發於兒童青少年，後三項好發於成人。
features: Table with two columns: diagnosis and usual patient age group
Pediatric/adolescent entities: EBV-positive HLH, systemic CAEBV, cutaneous CAEBV (hydroa vacciniforme-like LPD and severe mosquito bite allergy), systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood
Adult entities: aggressive NK-cell leukemia, extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma nasal type, nodal peripheral T-cell lymphoma EBV-positive
Footnote: nodal EBV-positive PTCL is included within PTCL, NOS in WHO 2016
62703.describe_en: This figure is a classification table rather than a morphologic image. It lists the WHO 2016 EBV-positive T-cell and NK-cell proliferations with their usual age groups: EBV-positive hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, systemic chronic active EBV infection, the cutaneous CAEBV forms (hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder and severe mosquito bite allergy) and systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma occur mainly in children and adolescents, whereas aggressive NK-cell leukemia, extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma nasal type, and nodal EBV-positive PTCL occur mainly in adults. It frames hydroa vacciniforme-like LPD as a cutaneous CAEBV spectrum disorder of the pediatric group.

62639.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，可見大量成群、核圓、細染色質、帶核仁與有絲分裂的紅血球前驅細胞，呈紅血球系增生，符合 PNH 溶血所致的代償反應；本身形態不具特異性。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a bony trabecula at left and scattered fat spaces
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round central nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli (early forms) plus smaller dark normoblasts
Frequent mitotic figures within erythroid islands
Megakaryocyte present near center with lobated nucleus
Occasional granulocytic precursors/eosinophils; scattered dark granular pigment deposits
62639.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a hypercellular marrow with marked erythroid hyperplasia, composed of sheets and islands of erythroid precursors with a left shift toward early forms and frequent mitoses. Megakaryocytes are present, and granulocytic elements are relatively reduced. No infiltrate of foreign cells or fibrosis is evident in this field. The findings reflect a reactive erythroid response to hemolysis and are consistent with the clinical diagnosis of PNH, which requires flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.dx: Pure erythroid leukemia (AML with erythroid predominance)
ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of highly atypical proerythroblasts (≥30%) with marked dysplasia, whereas here maturation through normoblasts is preserved.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant myeloid forms best seen on aspirate; B12/folate levels and absence of a GPI-deficient clone separate it.
Parvovirus produces giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and loss of later erythroid forms rather than full-spectrum erythroid hyperplasia.
Marrow morphology is identical; direct antiglobulin test, RBC morphology and FLAER flow cytometry discriminate.

62575.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E：一個濾泡的生發中心內充滿淡嗜雙性、細胞質豐富的大型漿母細胞，與周圍深色小淋巴球形成明顯對比，旁邊有小血管；大細胞集中在生發中心內，符合 HHV8 陽性親生發中心淋巴增生性疾病。
features: Follicular germinal center largely occupied by aggregates of large plasmablastic cells
Large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli
Surrounding rim of small dark mantle zone lymphocytes
Scattered small vessels and a few apoptotic bodies
Architecture preserved outside the involved follicle
62575.describe_en: Lymph node section at intermediate power shows a follicle whose germinal center is largely occupied by aggregates of large plasmablastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. These pale-staining aggregates contrast with the surrounding rim of small dark mantle zone lymphocytes, and a few small vessels and apoptotic bodies are present. The involvement is confined to the follicular compartment without diffuse effacement. Findings are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder, pending confirmation with HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers contain a polarized mix of centroblasts, centrocytes and tingible body macrophages that are CD20+/BCL6+, rather than cohesive clusters of CD20-negative plasmablasts.
FL grade 3 follicles are composed of CD20+/CD10+/BCL6+ centroblasts, usually BCL2+, and are HHV8/EBV negative.
MCD shows atrophic germinal centers with scattered single plasmablasts in the mantle zone rather than plasmablast aggregates filling the germinal center.

62511.recognize_zh: 淋巴球門內的 CD5 對 CD38 流式圖：淺藍色族群（推測為 CLL 的 B 細胞）CD5 弱陽性、CD38 表現分布很廣，有相當部分為 CD38 陽性；深紫色族群 CD5 較亮，推測為 T 細胞。CD38 陽性是 CLL 的不良預後指標，常見於 trisomy 12 的 CLL。
features: Lymphocyte-gated dot plot of CD5-PB (x-axis) versus CD38-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Light blue population with dim CD5 (~10^3) and broad, heterogeneous CD38 expression spanning ~10^2 to 10^5
Substantial fraction of the light blue population is CD38-positive
Dark purple population with brighter CD5 (~5 x 10^3), presumed T cells
Few gray CD5-negative, CD38-bright events, likely plasma cells or other CD38-bright cells
62511.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD5 versus CD38 on gated lymphocytes shows a dominant light blue population with dim CD5 and heterogeneous CD38 expression, a considerable portion of which is CD38-positive. A separate dark purple population with brighter CD5 is consistent with residual T cells. The exact percentage of CD38-positive cells cannot be determined from the plot alone and should be reported against the 30% threshold. Dim CD5 on the clonal B cells with a CD38-positive subset is consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with CD38 expression, an adverse prognostic marker often seen with trisomy 12.

ddx.vs: MCL is CD5-positive with frequent CD38 expression, but is CD23-negative with brighter CD20/sIg and cyclin D1.

ddx.dx: Reactive B cells with CD38 upregulation
ddx.vs: Reactive or germinal center-derived B cells are CD5-negative and polytypic.
A T-cell neoplasm would show abnormal CD5 intensity or loss on CD3-positive cells rather than dim CD5 on CD19-positive B cells.

62447.recognize_zh: 大腸黏膜切片中，表皮下方固有層有一條緻密、帶狀的 CD117 強陽性細胞浸潤，下方較深的固有層也有散在與小群聚的陽性細胞，而腺窩結構大致保留——這是黏膜內肥大細胞聚集的表現，提示肥大細胞增生症（mastocytosis）。
features: Colonic mucosa with preserved, evenly spaced crypts
Dense, band-like subepithelial aggregate of strongly CD117-positive cells in the superficial lamina propria
Additional scattered and small clusters of CD117-positive cells in the deeper lamina propria
Strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining of infiltrating cells; crypt epithelium shows only weak nonspecific staining
No surface ulceration or crypt destruction in this field
62447.describe_en: Colonic mucosal biopsy stained with CD117 (KIT) shows preserved crypt architecture with a dense, band-like aggregate of strongly CD117-positive cells beneath the surface epithelium. Additional CD117-positive cells are present singly and in small clusters in the deeper lamina propria. The crypt epithelium shows only weak background staining. The density and aggregation of CD117-positive cells far exceed the scattered mast cells of normal colonic mucosa; findings are consistent with mucosal involvement by mastocytosis, to be correlated with tryptase, CD25/CD2 co-expression and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.dx: Reactive mast cell increase (e.g., IBS, mastocytic enterocolitis)
ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are evenly scattered without compact aggregates of 15 or more cells and do not co-express CD25.
GIST is a CD117/DOG1-positive spindle cell mass arising in the muscularis propria rather than a superficial lamina propria infiltrate, and is tryptase-negative.
CD117 can mark myeloblasts, but these are blastic cells positive for CD34/MPO and negative for tryptase.
Eosinophil-rich lamina propria lacks sheets of CD117/tryptase-positive mast cells.

62383.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結中央有一大片淡粉紅色、境界不清的區域，周圍環繞深紫色的淋巴組織，對應嗜酸性膿瘍（eosinophilic abscess）；此放大倍率下無法辨認個別嗜酸性球。
features: Large, poorly circumscribed pale eosinophilic zone in the center of the field
Surrounding densely cellular basophilic lymphoid tissue with vague nodular (follicular) outlines
Cracking/retraction artifact within the eosinophilic area
Individual eosinophils and Charcot-Leyden crystals not resolvable at this magnification
62383.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a large, ill-defined pale eosinophilic area set within densely cellular lymphoid parenchyma with vague nodular contours suggestive of follicles. At this magnification the cellular composition of the pink zone cannot be confirmed; higher power would be needed to document sheets of eosinophils and necrosis. In context, the appearance is compatible with an eosinophilic abscess in a background of follicular hyperplasia; parasitic infection, Kimura disease, and IgG4-related disease should be considered clinically.

ddx.vs: Kimura disease shows florid follicular hyperplasia with IgE deposits in germinal centers, vascular proliferation, and eosinophilic microabscesses, typically in head and neck nodes of young Asian men with high serum IgE.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with eosinophil-rich background
ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and effaced architecture rather than preserved reactive follicles.
LCH shows sinusoidal clusters of grooved CD1a+/langerin+ histiocytes accompanying the eosinophilic abscesses.
Granulomatous abscesses are rimmed by palisading epithelioid histiocytes and contain neutrophils and necrotic debris rather than predominantly eosinophils.

62319.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中大多數紅血球的中央淡染區不是圓形，而是變成一條細長的裂縫或嘴巴狀（slit-like / mouth-like），這就是口形紅血球（stomatocyte），數量眾多時稱為口形紅血球增多症。
features: Numerous red cells with a linear, slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (stomatocytes)
Stomatocytes are present throughout the field rather than only in a thick or thin area of the smear
Mild anisocytosis with some slightly larger red cells
Occasional small dense red cells; no significant spherocytes or target cells
Scattered platelets; no leukocytes in this field
62319.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red blood cells in which the normal round central pallor is replaced by an elongated slit-like or mouth-shaped area of pallor, consistent with stomatocytes. They are distributed across the field, with mild anisocytosis and no significant spherocytes, target cells or schistocytes. Platelets are present. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis; smear artifact should be excluded by review of well-spread areas and a fresh smear, and correlation with red cell indices (MCV, MCHC), alcohol history, liver disease and hereditary stomatocytosis workup is recommended.

ddx.vs: Artifact stomatocytes appear in thick areas or slowly dried smears and disappear on a fresh, well-spread smear, whereas true stomatocytosis persists across the monolayer.
Spherocytes are small dense round cells with no central pallor, not cells with a linear slit of pallor.
SAO shows oval red cells with one or two transverse bars or slits (knizocyte-like), plus a characteristic 27-bp SLC4A1 deletion.
Target cells have a central dense spot within a ring of pallor rather than a single linear slit.

62255.recognize_zh: 視野中央的嗜中性球體積偏大，核分成 6 葉以上、以細絲相連，上方另一顆也有 5 葉，明顯多於正常的 3–4 葉，這就是核分葉過多的嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），是巨母紅血球性貧血的周邊血線索。
features: Central neutrophil enlarged relative to neighbors with at least 6 nuclear lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments
Second neutrophil (upper left) with 5 distinct lobes
Normal pale pink granular neutrophil cytoplasm without toxic granulation or Döhle bodies
Lower neutrophil with fewer lobes serves as a comparison
Red cells mildly anisocytic with some larger forms; platelets adequate
62255.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with increased nuclear segmentation, including a central, enlarged neutrophil with six or more lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments and a second neutrophil with five lobes. The neutrophil cytoplasm shows normal granulation without toxic changes or Döhle bodies. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with some larger forms, although oval macrocytosis is not striking in this field, and platelets appear adequate. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation, which in the appropriate context suggests megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: This rare autosomal dominant trait shows hypersegmentation without macrocytosis, anemia or abnormal B12/folate levels.
Drug-related hypersegmentation is identical morphologically and is identified by medication history with normal vitamin levels.
Pelger-Huët cells show the opposite change, with bilobed 'pince-nez' or non-lobulated nuclei.
Delayed smear preparation causes nuclear degeneration with pyknotic, fragmented lobes rather than well-formed lobes linked by filaments.

62127.recognize_zh: 淋巴結高倍視野中，一個濾泡的生發中心邊界被破壞，淡染的組織球與嗜酸性物質侵入並打散生發中心細胞，套區不完整，即濾泡溶解（folliculolysis），是 Kimura 病的特徵之一。
features: Germinal center with disrupted, irregular borders and loss of the sharp mantle interface
Infiltration of the germinal center by pale histiocytes, eosinophilic material and scattered inflammatory cells
Mixed centroblasts and centrocytes separated into irregular clusters
Surrounding sheets of small mature lymphocytes
Small vessel within the follicle; eosinophils difficult to resolve individually at this magnification
62127.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a reactive follicle whose germinal center has ill-defined, disrupted borders. The germinal center is infiltrated and broken up by pale histiocytes, eosinophilic proteinaceous material and scattered inflammatory cells, with residual centroblasts and centrocytes in irregular clusters. The mantle zone is attenuated and surrounded by sheets of small lymphocytes. No atypical large cells are seen. Findings are consistent with folliculolysis, which in the context of eosinophilia and eosinophilic microabscesses supports Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: HIV lymphadenitis shows florid follicular hyperplasia with folliculolysis and polykaryocytes but lacks eosinophilic microabscesses, with HIV serology confirming.
PTGC shows large nodules in which mantle lymphocytes invade the germinal center without eosinophilic material or histiocytic disruption.
Neoplastic follicles are back-to-back, monotonous, lack tingible body macrophages and are BCL2 positive, unlike disrupted reactive germinal centers.
IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4-positive plasma cells with an IgG4/IgG ratio above 40% rather than IgE deposits and eosinophilic microabscesses.

62063.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大量偏心核的漿細胞與淡染組織球混合浸潤，並散在一顆嗜酸性球，左上方有粉紅色膠原與梭形細胞構成的纖維化區，呈現漿細胞增生合併硬化的反應性淋巴結炎。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate with numerous plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs
Admixed histiocytes with vesicular oval nuclei and pale, focally vacuolated cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes and an occasional eosinophil with bright red granules
Collagenous sclerosis with streaming spindle cells at the upper left
Focal endothelial-lined spaces; no sheets of large atypical cells
62063.describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows a polymorphous inflammatory infiltrate composed of numerous plasma cells, histiocytes with vesicular nuclei, small lymphocytes, and an occasional eosinophil. A zone of collagenous sclerosis with streaming spindle cells is present at the upper left of the field. There are no sheets of atypical large cells or Reed-Sternberg-like cells, and no necrosis is identified. Findings are consistent with reactive lymphadenitis with plasmacytosis and sclerosis, suggestive of syphilitic lymphadenitis in the proper clinical setting; Treponema immunostain and serology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Mixed cellularity CHL also has plasma cells and eosinophils, but contains diagnostic CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are not seen here.
Castleman disease shows interfollicular plasma cell sheets with abnormal follicles and prominent vascularity, without spirochetes on immunostaining.
IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4+ plasma cells with a raised IgG4/IgG ratio and storiform fibrosis, with negative Treponema staining.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with reactive background
ddx.vs: PTCL shows cytologically atypical medium-to-large T cells with aberrant immunophenotype and clonal TCR rearrangement, beyond the bland cytology present here.

61999.recognize_zh: 免疫染色（棕色）顯示密集成片的細胞呈強而完整的環狀膜染色，細胞形狀一致、核位於中央偏淡；這張是膜型標記（抗原未標示，可能為 CD138 或 CD20），表示腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫性浸潤，但 cyclin D1 為核染色，無法由此圖判讀。
features: Diffuse sheets of cells with strong circumferential membranous DAB staining
Cells are relatively uniform, round to polygonal, with pale unstained nuclei
Near-complete replacement of the field by positive cells
Occasional negative large cell (possibly megakaryocyte) and vascular/stromal spaces
Antigen not labeled; nuclear detail obscured by strong membranous staining
61999.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (DAB; antigen not labeled) shows diffuse sheets of uniform cells with strong circumferential membranous staining, replacing nearly the entire field, with a rare negative large cell and small stromal spaces. In the context of plasma cell myeloma with t(11;14), the membranous pattern is compatible with CD138 highlighting a diffuse plasma cell infiltrate, or CD20, which is frequently expressed in t(11;14) myeloma. Cyclin D1 expression (nuclear) is not demonstrated in this image; the antigen should be confirmed with the case materials.

ddx.vs: MCL is CD5+/CD20+/SOX11+ and CD138 negative, whereas t(11;14) myeloma is CD138+ with cytoplasmic light chain restriction and often dim or absent CD45.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, CD20+ and usually CD138 negative.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is CD138+ but typically has immunoblastic cytology, high Ki-67, frequent EBER positivity and MYC rearrangement.

61871.recognize_zh: 五格血片中的淋巴球核偏圓或腎形、染色質均勻，細胞質淡藍且周邊呈毛絨絨、細絲狀的突起（hairy projections），這是毛細胞白血病型態；標題特別強調在兒童身上出現，屬罕見情境，需以免疫表型確認。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Circumferential fine, frayed cytoplasmic projections (hairy/ruffled borders)
Round to oval, eccentric nuclei with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin
No conspicuous nucleoli in the high-power panels
Background red cells without evident blasts at low power
61871.describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear (panels A–E) shows scattered atypical lymphoid cells at low power (A, B) with detailed views at high power (C–E). The cells are medium-sized with oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin without prominent nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine, circumferential hair-like projections. The morphology is that of hairy cells; given the pediatric setting, where hairy cell leukemia is exceptionally rare, confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is required. Findings are suggestive of hairy cell leukemia in an unusual age group.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a distinct nucleolus and are CD25-/CD123- and BRAF V600E wild-type, whereas classic HCL shows no prominent nucleolus and is CD25+/CD123+/BRAF-mutated.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar projections with more condensed chromatin rather than circumferential fine hairs, and lack CD103/annexin A1.
Reactive large granular or activated lymphocytes lack the uniform circumferential projections and the clonal HCL immunophenotype.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, gray cytoplasm with fine vacuoles, and express CD14/CD64 rather than B-cell markers.

61807.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖（非形態圖）：在 blast gate 中，細胞群 CD33 一致陽性，CD13 由弱至中等陽性，表示母細胞為骨髓系（myeloid）表現型。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on blasts: CD13-PE (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Single dominant population with uniform moderate CD33 expression
CD13 expression is heterogeneous, ranging from dim to moderate
Small scattered CD13/CD33 double-negative events in the lower left
61807.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the gated blast population shows a single dominant population with uniform moderate CD33 expression and heterogeneous dim-to-moderate CD13 expression. Only a small minority of events is negative for both markers. This co-expression of CD13 and CD33 establishes a myeloid immunophenotype for the blasts, consistent with a myeloid neoplasm in this GATA2 germline case; lineage and maturation stage require the full panel (CD34, CD117, HLA-DR, monocytic markers).

61743.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交在粉紅色對比染色背景中，可見許多深藍黑色的陽性細胞核，大小不一，包括數個大型、形狀不規則的非典型細胞核；EBV 陽性大型 B 細胞是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的診斷關鍵。
features: Numerous nuclei with dark blue-black EBER signal on a pink (nuclear fast red) counterstain
EBER-positive cells vary in size, including large atypical cells with irregular, multilobated nuclei
Small EBER-positive nuclei also present
Background of EBER-negative cells with pale cytoplasm and necrotic-appearing matrix
61743.describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) shows numerous positive nuclei of variable size, including large atypical cells with irregular nuclear contours, set in a background of EBER-negative cells. The density of positive cells appears high in this field, although formal counting per high-power field is not possible from a single image. Findings support an EBV-driven B-cell lymphoproliferation and, with the angiocentric pattern and CD20 staining, are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, likely of higher grade.

ddx.vs: Both are EBER-positive and angiocentric, but in ENKTL the EBER-positive cells coexpress CD56 and cytoplasmic CD3 rather than CD20.
EBVMCU is a sharply circumscribed superficial ulcer in immunosuppressed patients, not a multifocal angiodestructive lung-based process.
EBER-positive cells in CHL are CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with weak or absent CD20 and PAX5-dim staining.

61679.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴樣細胞比小淋巴球稍大，核圓至橢圓、染色質中度濃縮，中央隱約可見一個小核仁，細胞質深嗜鹼性且左緣有小突起（cytoplasmic bleb），這些是 T 前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）細胞的線索，但需免疫表型確認。
features: Single medium-sized lymphoid cell, larger than a small mature lymphocyte
Moderate N:C ratio with round to slightly oval, eccentric nucleus
Moderately condensed, somewhat clumped chromatin with a faint small central nucleolus
Moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm without granules
Small cytoplasmic protrusion (bleb) at the left cell border
Background normocytic red cells without other leukocytes in field
61679.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized atypical lymphoid cell among unremarkable red cells. The cell has a round to oval nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and a small, inconspicuous nucleolus, surrounded by a moderate rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with a small cytoplasmic bleb. A single cell cannot establish the diagnosis, but in context the morphology is consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD3+, CD7 bright) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-lineage prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and paler cytoplasm without blebs, and flow cytometry shows B-cell markers rather than CD3/CD7.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are CD7 negative/CD26 negative, whereas T-PLL cells have rounder nuclei and basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous, with abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and basophilia at the periphery, rather than a monotonous population with blebs.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections, pale gray-blue cytoplasm and an oval or bean-shaped nucleus with no nucleolus, and are CD11c/CD25/CD103 positive B cells.

61615.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見大片中大型不成熟細胞，核圓至卵圓、部分有凹陷，染色質細緻、可見小核仁，正常成熟造血細胞稀少，並散見含鐵血黃素巨噬細胞，符合 AML 芽細胞浸潤。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei
Fine chromatin with small distinct nucleoli; moderate pale cytoplasm
Few residual maturing neutrophils, erythroid precursors, and a scattered eosinophil
Numerous hemosiderin-laden macrophages with golden-brown pigment
Dilated sinusoids and fat spaces at the periphery
61615.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of medium-to-large blasts with round to oval, sometimes indented nuclei, fine chromatin, small distinct nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm. Residual maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and eosinophils are sparse, and hemosiderin-laden macrophages are scattered throughout. No significant megakaryocytic dysplasia is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; subclassification as AML with mutated CEBPA requires molecular analysis.

ddx.vs: AML-MR shows multilineage dysplasia (e.g., dysplastic megakaryocytes) or MDS-defining cytogenetics/mutations, which are not evident here.
Monocytic blasts have more abundant cytoplasm and markedly folded nuclei, with CD14/CD163/lysozyme positivity.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant cytoplasm and are TdT-positive, MPO-negative on immunostaining.

61551.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 PAX5 染色中，少數小型反應性 B 細胞呈深褐色強核染，而中央的大型 HRS 細胞只呈弱而淡的染色，這種「大細胞弱、小 B 細胞強」的 PAX5 對比是 CHL 的重要線索。
features: Large atypical cell (center) with weak, pale brown staining that is much fainter than surrounding small B cells
Staining in the large cell appears somewhat granular and partly obscures the nucleus
Rare small lymphocytes with strong nuclear PAX5 (internal positive control)
Background stromal cells, histiocytes and T cells negative in a loose fibrotic stroma
61551.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for PAX5 on a bone marrow biopsy shows rare small lymphocytes with strong nuclear staining that serve as an internal control. A large atypical cell in the center of the field shows only weak, pale staining, markedly dimmer than the background B cells; the staining appears somewhat granular. The surrounding fibrotic infiltrate is otherwise negative. Weak PAX5 expression in the large cells, together with CD30 and CD15 positivity and CD20 negativity, supports classic Hodgkin lymphoma involving marrow.

ddx.vs: ALCL cells are PAX5-negative, so weak PAX5 in the large cells favors HRS cells over ALCL.
Neoplastic large B cells show strong PAX5 equal to or brighter than background B cells, together with CD20 and OCT2/BOB1 expression.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific staining of a megakaryocyte or histiocyte
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes and histiocytes are PAX5-negative and any cytoplasmic blush lacks nuclear localization; correlation with CD30/CD15 and H&E morphology confirms the cell type.

61487.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中血小板數量少，箭頭標示的血小板偏大且呈淡灰藍色；高倍（B、C）可見與紅血球等大或更大的巨大血小板，細胞質淡灰、幾乎沒有紫色 α 顆粒，符合灰色血小板症候群（gray platelet syndrome）。
features: Panel A: thrombocytopenia with only scattered platelets (arrows), several enlarged and pale
Panels B and C: giant platelets approaching or exceeding red cell size
Platelet cytoplasm pale gray-blue and largely agranular, with only faint residual granular stippling
Red cells and background otherwise unremarkable; no platelet clumps or satellitism seen
61487.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows thrombocytopenia with scattered enlarged platelets (arrows, panel A). At high power (panels B and C), the platelets are large to giant, comparable to or larger than red cells, with pale gray-blue cytoplasm that lacks normal purple azurophilic (alpha) granules. Red cell morphology is otherwise unremarkable and no platelet clumping is present. Findings are consistent with gray platelet syndrome (alpha-granule deficiency); confirmation by electron microscopy showing absent alpha granules and NBEAL2 genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Giant platelets in Bernard-Soulier retain normal purple granules, and the defect is absent ristocetin aggregation with GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
MYH9 disorders have normally granulated giant platelets plus Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils.
Artifactual pale platelets are normal-sized and disappear on a fresh or citrated sample, whereas gray platelets are large and persistent.
ITP has large but well-granulated platelets, while here the platelets are distinctly agranular and gray.

61423.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆巨噬細胞核周圍的淡色胞質內散布數十個均一的小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），明顯比周圍顆粒小，符合利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體。
features: Macrophage with a single oval nucleus and pale, ill-defined cytoplasm filled with numerous small oval purple organisms
Organisms uniform, about 2-4 um, discrete and evenly scattered around the nucleus
Some organisms show a faint paired dot, but kinetoplast detail is limited at this magnification
Adjacent lymphocytes, band neutrophil, erythroblast and a monocyte-like cell in the background
Red cells free of parasites
61423.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose pale cytoplasm contains numerous small, uniform, oval basophilic organisms distributed around the nucleus. Surrounding cells include lymphocytes, maturing neutrophils and erythroid precursors, without other abnormal populations in this field. Internal kinetoplast detail is only faintly discernible at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies (Leishmania amastigotes), supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo, lack a kinetoplast and are GMS/PAS-positive.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with a central septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Platelets and debris are irregular and granular, without the uniform oval shape and nucleus-kinetoplast structure of amastigotes.

61295.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮內被成片、單一的大型淋巴樣細胞瀰漫取代，細胞核圓、空泡狀並有核仁，浸潤在粗大膠原束之間，右下仍可見表皮或附屬器上皮；這種大型圓形母細胞樣細胞成片浸潤真皮，是腿型原發皮膚瀰漫大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（PCDLBCL, leg type）的樣子。
features: Diffuse, dense sheet-like infiltrate of large atypical lymphoid cells occupying the dermis
Monotonous large cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei and conspicuous nucleoli (centroblast/immunoblast-like)
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; numerous cells in close apposition
Infiltrate dissects between thick eosinophilic dermal collagen bundles and around small vessels
Epithelium (epidermis/adnexal structure) at the lower right; few admixed small reactive lymphocytes
61295.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate that dissects between collagen bundles and surrounds small vessels. The infiltrate is composed of monotonous sheets of large lymphoid cells with round vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and scant amphophilic cytoplasm, with few admixed small lymphocytes. A follicular or nodular architecture with centrocytes is not seen in this field. Immunohistochemistry (CD20, BCL2, MUM1, FOXP1, IgM) is required for confirmation. Findings are consistent with primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, diffuse pattern
ddx.vs: Usually on head or trunk with large cleaved centrocytes admixed with reactive T cells and stroma, and typically BCL2-negative/MUM1-negative, whereas leg type shows sheets of round centroblasts/immunoblasts that are strongly BCL2+, MUM1+ and IgM+.

ddx.dx: Systemic DLBCL with secondary cutaneous involvement
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; staging showing nodal or systemic disease at presentation distinguishes it.
Blasts have finer chromatin and may be admixed with eosinophilic myelocytes, and are MPO/CD33/CD117 positive rather than CD20/PAX5 positive.
Cells have salt-and-pepper chromatin, nuclear molding and brisk apoptosis and express CK20 (dot-like) and neuroendocrine markers rather than CD45/CD20.

61231.recognize_zh: H&E 淋巴結切片中可見大量小淋巴球與漿細胞，其間散布成群、胞質淡染豐富的大型組織球，部分組織球內隱約可見被包入的淋巴球，提示 Rosai-Dorfman 病，但此放大倍率下擴張的淋巴竇與胞吞現象並不清楚。
features: Dense polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes with numerous plasma cells
Scattered aggregates of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei
Occasional histiocytes appear to contain small lymphocytes within the cytoplasm (emperipolesis), not well resolved at this power
Thin fibrous septa and small vessels traversing the infiltrate
Nodal sinus architecture is not clearly appreciable in this field
61231.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at intermediate power shows a dense mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells with scattered aggregates of large histiocytes having abundant pale cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei. A few histiocytes appear to harbor intracytoplasmic lymphocytes, although emperipolesis is not well resolved at this magnification. Dilated sinuses are not clearly demonstrated in this particular field. The findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease, best confirmed by higher-power demonstration of emperipolesis and S100-positive, CD1a-negative histiocytes.

ddx.vs: The mixed background contains diagnostic Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) rather than bland S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.
Features sinusoidal Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei and abundant eosinophils, CD1a/langerin positive.
Sinus histiocytes are smaller, S100 negative and lack emperipolesis, with preserved nodal architecture.

61167.recognize_zh: 抹片（A）中是大型、細胞質布滿大小不一泡泡狀空泡、細胞核圓且常為雙核的上皮樣細胞，切片（B、C）呈淡染、泡狀細胞位於黏液樣基質中，這種「含空泡細胞」（physaliphorous cell）是脊索瘤（chordoma）的特徵，標題「chord」即暗示此診斷。
features: Panel A (aspirate smear): large cohesive cells with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm containing multiple variably sized clear vacuoles (physaliphorous/bubbly cells)
Round, eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; frequent binucleate forms and small nucleoli
Panel B (core biopsy, low power): marrow spaces between trabeculae replaced by a pale, lobulated, hypocellular tumor
Panel C: cords and single vacuolated cells embedded in a pale myxoid/chondroid-like matrix
Panels D/E: diffuse cytoplasmic and nuclear (D) and membranous (E) immunohistochemical positivity; antigens not labeled in figure
Panel F: strong magenta staining of tumor cells and matrix, consistent with PAS or mucin-type histochemical stain
61167.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of large non-hematopoietic cells with abundant pale cytoplasm filled with multiple clear vacuoles of varying sizes and round eccentric nuclei, including binucleate forms. The core biopsy shows intertrabecular spaces replaced by a pale, lobulated tumor composed of cords and single vacuolated cells in a myxoid matrix. Immunostains show diffuse cytoplasmic/nuclear and membranous positivity in the tumor cells (antigens not labeled), and a histochemical stain highlights the cells and matrix in magenta. Findings are suggestive of metastatic chordoma involving the marrow; brachyury (TBXT), cytokeratin and S100 immunostains confirm this diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring cell or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells have a single mucin vacuole indenting the nucleus or clear glycogenated cytoplasm without myxoid matrix, and are brachyury negative.
Chondrosarcoma cells sit in lacunae within hyaline/chondroid matrix and are S100 positive but cytokeratin and brachyury negative.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper cytoplasm and foamy histiocytes have fine uniform vacuoles, both CD68 positive and non-cohesive.
Gelatinous transformation shows acellular pale extracellular material with hypoplastic marrow rather than cohesive atypical vacuolated tumor cells.

61103.recognize_zh: 同一張血片中並列正常分葉的嗜中性球與細胞縮小、核濃縮成數個圓形深染碎塊（核碎裂，karyorrhexis）的嗜中性球，並可見一個僅剩圓形核碎片的小型凋亡小體，即嗜中性球凋亡的各階段。
features: Shrunken neutrophils with dense, homogeneously condensed (pyknotic) nuclear chromatin and more eosinophilic cytoplasm (panel A)
Nuclear fragmentation into multiple round, smooth, darkly staining spheres (karyorrhexis) within intact cytoplasm (panels B, C)
Small apoptotic body composed of a few dense nuclear fragments with scant cytoplasm (panel D)
Normal segmented neutrophils in the same fields for comparison
Background red cells with echinocytes (crenated cells), consistent with smear/storage artifact contribution
61103.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows, alongside morphologically normal segmented neutrophils, occasional neutrophils at progressive stages of apoptosis: cell shrinkage with pyknotic chromatin, fragmentation of the nucleus into multiple round dense spheres, and a small apoptotic body with residual nuclear fragments. The fragments are smooth and round rather than lobulated, distinguishing them from hypersegmentation. Echinocytes are present in the background. In the clinical context of MDS, findings are consistent with apoptotic neutrophils in peripheral blood; storage artifact should be excluded by reviewing a freshly prepared smear.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented nuclei retain connected lobes with normal chromatin texture, whereas apoptotic nuclei break into separate, round, homogeneously dense spheres in a shrunken cell.
Storage artifact affects many leukocytes diffusely with nuclear lobe rounding and vacuolation in a sample older than several hours; a fresh smear resolves it.

ddx.dx: Nucleated red blood cell with Howell-Jolly bodies
ddx.vs: An nRBC has hemoglobinized cytoplasm and a single dense nucleus, lacking the granular neutrophil cytoplasm and multiple nuclear spheres.
Pseudo-Pelger cells have bilobed or round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin but no nuclear fragmentation or cell shrinkage.

61039.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下淋巴結結構完全被瀰漫浸潤取代、看不到濾泡與邊緣竇，間質中可見許多分枝狀小血管，浸潤並越過被膜延伸到周圍脂肪組織；這種「結構抹除＋血管增生＋結外延伸」的組合提示 AITL。
features: Complete effacement of nodal architecture; no residual follicles or open subcapsular sinus identified
Diffuse polymorphous-appearing infiltrate with a mottled pale/dark pattern at low power
Prominent arborizing small vessels scattered throughout the node (hypervascularity)
Infiltrate extends through the capsule into perinodal adipose tissue
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
