61039.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a lymph node shows complete effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate with a mottled appearance. Numerous branching small vessels are present throughout, imparting a hypervascular appearance. The peripheral (subcapsular) sinus is not identifiable, and the infiltrate extends beyond the capsule into the perinodal adipose tissue. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification; in conjunction with TFH-marker immunohistochemistry and expanded FDC meshworks, the findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive nodes retain follicles and patent sinuses and do not show capsular breach with perinodal fat infiltration.
Can efface the node similarly, but lacks the characteristic arborizing HEV proliferation, extrafollicular FDC expansion and TFH phenotype.
Separated at higher power by Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-weak phenotype in a mixed inflammatory background.
Shows scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background without FDC meshwork expansion or TFH-marker-positive neoplastic T cells.

60975.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中兩個偏心圓核的漿細胞共用一片強嗜鹼性、邊緣呈纖維狀毛邊的細胞質，細胞質內隱約有粉紫色細絲狀結構；本圖解析度不足，題目所稱的類 Auer 棒狀包涵體無法清楚辨認。
features: Two plasma cells (or a binucleate plasma cell) with round eccentric nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin
Abundant, intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a fibrillary, frayed and streaming border
Faint pink-purple wisps within the cytoplasm; discrete Auer rod-like needles not clearly resolved
Sparse background with scattered red cells showing drying artifact
60975.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two closely apposed plasma cells, possibly a binucleate form, with round eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a fibrillary, frayed border. Faint pink-purple filamentous material is present within the cytoplasm, but discrete rod-shaped azurophilic inclusions are not clearly resolved at this resolution. The red cells in the background show drying artifact. The plasma cells are compatible with the reported myeloma, but the Auer rod-like inclusions in the title are only partially demonstrated in this field.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and lack crystalline inclusions or multinucleation; clonality by kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry is required.
Flame cells show fuchsinophilic red-pink cytoplasm with frayed edges rather than deep blue cytoplasm with crystalline rods.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods are in blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and MPO positivity, not in mature plasma cells with clumped chromatin.
Osteoblasts also have eccentric nuclei and blue cytoplasm but are larger, comet-shaped, occur in clusters and have a hof separated from the nucleus.

60911.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大量大小不一的巨核細胞成群聚集，許多細胞核小、分葉少、細胞質豐富粉紅，夾雜較小的原始樣細胞與梭形細胞；在唐氏症兒童背景下，這種明顯的異型巨核細胞增生提示唐氏症相關骨髓性白血病（ML-DS）。
features: Marked proliferation of megakaryocytes forming clusters and sheets, ranging from small to large forms
Many megakaryocytes are dysplastic: small hypolobated or mononuclear nuclei with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Interspersed smaller cells with high N:C ratio and oval nuclei, compatible with megakaryoblasts/immature cells
Spindled nuclei and streaming in the lower right, suggesting stromal fibrosis
Near-complete effacement of normal trilineage hematopoiesis and fat; hemorrhage and bone fragment at lower right
60911.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows a hypercellular marrow effaced by a proliferation of atypical megakaryocytes arranged in clusters and sheets. The megakaryocytes vary markedly in size and many have small hypolobated or monolobated nuclei with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with smaller immature cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Areas with spindled nuclei suggest associated reticulin fibrosis, and normal erythroid and granulocytic elements are sparse. In a child with Down syndrome and prior transient abnormal myelopoiesis, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (megakaryoblastic).

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated or cloud-like nuclei in an adult, whereas this pediatric Down syndrome marrow shows small hypolobated megakaryocytes with megakaryoblasts, confirmed by GATA1 mutation.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia without Down syndrome (e.g. RBM15::MRTFA)
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap; the distinction rests on the constitutional trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation versus the RBM15::MRTFA fusion or CBFA2T3::GLIS2 in non-DS infants.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor with fibrosis (e.g. neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive nests and are CD61/CD42b negative, while the lesional cells here are megakaryocytic and express platelet glycoproteins.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobated, dispersed rather than sheeted, without megakaryoblasts or marrow fibrosis.

60847.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有一團與周圍造血細胞界線清楚的黏聚性腫瘤細胞巢，左圖 synaptophysin 呈顆粒狀胞質與纖維狀（neuropil）陽性，右圖 PGP9.5 強陽性，兩者共同支持神經母細胞瘤的神經內分泌分化。
features: Two-panel figure of bone marrow biopsy immunostains, each showing a discrete cohesive nest of tumor cells among fat and hematopoietic cells
Left (synaptophysin): granular cytoplasmic and fibrillary (neuropil-like) staining throughout the tumor cluster
Right (PGP9.5): strong cytoplasmic and nuclear staining of tumor cells with fibrillary processes at the periphery
Tumor cells with round nuclei and high N:C ratio, larger and more crowded than surrounding marrow cells
Background hematopoietic cells and adipocytes negative, serving as internal negative control
60847.describe_en: Two immunohistochemical stains performed on a bone marrow biopsy each highlight a discrete cohesive nest of tumor cells within otherwise normal-appearing marrow with adipocytes and hematopoietic cells. Synaptophysin (left) shows granular cytoplasmic and fibrillary neuropil-like positivity throughout the cluster, and PGP9.5 (right) shows strong cytoplasmic and nuclear staining with fibrillary processes. Surrounding hematopoietic elements are negative. Findings support neuroendocrine/neural differentiation and are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.vs: Rhabdomyosarcoma forms similar nests but is desmin and myogenin positive and generally negative for PGP9.5 and synaptophysin (though aberrant synaptophysin/CD56 can occur).
Ewing sarcoma is CD99 and NKX2.2 positive and typically lacks fibrillary neuropil and strong PHOX2B/PGP9.5 expression.
Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive, not synaptophysin positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small cell carcinoma / neuroendocrine carcinoma
ddx.vs: Occurs in adults and is keratin positive (dot-like), whereas neuroblastoma is pediatric, keratin negative and PHOX2B positive.

60783.recognize_zh: 瀰漫排列的中型淋巴瘤細胞大多呈強的 cyclin D1 核染色（並帶部分細胞質著色），而夾雜的小淋巴球、內皮細胞與組織球為陰性，在 CD20 陽性的 B 細胞淋巴瘤中即支持被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Strong nuclear cyclin D1 staining in the large majority of tumor cells, with some cytoplasmic blush
Admixed small reactive lymphocytes, endothelial cells and histiocytes are negative (blue counterstain), serving as internal negative control
Thin vascular channels traverse the infiltrate
60783.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for cyclin D1 shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells, the great majority of which show strong nuclear staining with some cytoplasmic accentuation. Interspersed small lymphocytes, endothelial cells and histiocytes are negative. In a CD20-positive lymphoma with blastoid cytology and a very high proliferation index, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant; CCND1 FISH can confirm t(11;14) if needed.

ddx.vs: Also cyclin D1 positive, but cells are plasma cells that are CD138+ and CD20/PAX5 negative with cytoplasmic light chain restriction.
Shows weak to moderate cyclin D1 in a subset but has bland cells with abundant cytoplasm, CD103/CD25/annexin A1 positivity and BRAF V600E without t(11;14).

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, cyclin D1-positive
ddx.vs: Rare cases show weak/partial cyclin D1 without CCND1 rearrangement, SOX11 negativity and larger centroblastic or immunoblastic cells.
Has identical morphology but lacks cyclin D1 staining and instead shows SOX11 positivity with CCND2 or CCND3 rearrangement.

60591.recognize_zh: 左圖為水腫、中央有間質鬆散化的絨毛，周圍滋養層細胞增生，符合葡萄胎（hydatidiform mole）；右圖周邊血液出現大型、核質比高、細胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞，提示葡萄胎化療（如 etoposide）後發生的治療相關急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Tissue: enlarged hydropic chorionic villi with edematous, loose myxoid stroma
Circumferential trophoblastic proliferation lining the villi, with hemorrhage in the background
Peripheral blood: large blasts with high N:C ratio, irregular to folded nuclei, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Blasts with somewhat monocytoid nuclear contours; Auer rods not seen at this resolution
60591.describe_en: Section of uterine contents shows enlarged hydropic chorionic villi with edematous, paucicellular stroma and circumferential trophoblastic proliferation, consistent with a hydatidiform mole. The peripheral blood smear shows circulating large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and basophilic cytoplasm. In a patient previously treated for a molar pregnancy, findings are consistent with a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm (acute myeloid leukemia post cytotoxic therapy), most often associated with topoisomerase II inhibitors such as etoposide and KMT2A rearrangements with a short latency.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; the history of prior cytotoxic therapy defines the therapy-related category.

ddx.dx: Metastatic choriocarcinoma/gestational trophoblastic neoplasm in blood or marrow
ddx.vs: Trophoblastic cells are cohesive, multinucleated syncytiotrophoblast with hCG and keratin positivity, not CD45+ myeloid blasts.
Alkylator-related disease presents after a longer latency (5-10 years) with dysplasia and -5/-7 or TP53, rather than abrupt AML with balanced 11q23 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Partial hydatidiform mole or hydropic abortus
ddx.vs: Show only focal villous edema and minimal trophoblast hyperplasia with p57 retained (partial) rather than diffuse hydropic change with circumferential proliferation.

60655.recognize_zh: 周邊血的母細胞在一端伸出一個淡藍色胞質尾突（uropod，箭頭），整體形如手鏡，即手鏡細胞（hand-mirror cell）；核染色質細緻、有小空泡，尾突內可見顆粒（箭頭頭），這種形態不能決定系列，需靠流式細胞分析。
features: Large blast with high N:C ratio and fine, open chromatin
Distinct unipolar cytoplasmic projection (uropod) giving a hand-mirror shape (arrows)
Cytoplasm concentrated in the uropod, pale basophilic, with a few fine granules (arrowheads)
Irregular nuclear contour with small nuclear/cytoplasmic vacuoles
No Auer rods visible in these two cells
60655.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and irregular nuclear outlines. The scant pale basophilic cytoplasm is gathered into a single tail-like uropod, producing a hand-mirror configuration, and a few fine granules are present within the uropod. Auer rods are not identified in these cells. Hand-mirror morphology is lineage-nonspecific and has been described in both ALL and AML; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry and cytochemistry, which in this case supported acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with hand-mirror cells
ddx.vs: Hand-mirror morphology occurs in ALL as well, so the discriminator is immunophenotype (CD19/CD79a or cCD3 and TdT versus MPO/CD33/CD117), not the uropod.
LGLs have mature condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm with azurophilic granules, not blast chromatin with a focal uropod.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have abundant gray-blue, often vacuolated cytoplasm surrounding folded nuclei rather than cytoplasm concentrated in one pole; NSE and CD14/CD64 help.
Artifactual blebs are multiple, detached, or seen at the smear edge, whereas a uropod is a single, attached polar projection present in many cells.

60719.recognize_zh: 心包膜纖維組織表面與內部有密集、單一型的小型淋巴球浸潤，高倍插圖為成片的小圓核淋巴球，兩種免疫染色皆呈瀰漫陽性，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病／小淋巴球性淋巴瘤侵犯心包膜。
features: Low power (A): pericardial fibrous tissue with a dense band-like and nodular lymphoid infiltrate along the surface and extending into the wall
Inset: sheets of monotonous small lymphocytes with round dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
No large transformed cells or distinct proliferation centers identifiable at this magnification
IHC (B): diffuse strong staining of the lymphoid infiltrate (marker unlabeled)
IHC (C): diffuse, somewhat weaker staining of the same population (marker unlabeled; compatible with co-expression such as CD5 or CD23)
60719.describe_en: Sections of pericardium show fibrous tissue with a dense infiltrate of lymphoid cells along the surface and within the wall. At higher magnification the infiltrate consists of sheets of monotonous small lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm; large cells or proliferation centers are not evident at this magnification. Two immunohistochemical stains (not labeled in the figure) diffusely highlight the infiltrate. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD20 weak, CD5+, CD23+, LEF1+), findings are consistent with pericardial involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive pericarditis has a mixed infiltrate of lymphocytes, plasma cells and histiocytes with fibrin, rather than monotonous sheets of B cells co-expressing CD5 and CD23.
MCL cells have irregular notched nuclei and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD23 negative.
MZL shows monocytoid cells with pale cytoplasm and plasmacytic differentiation and is CD5 and CD23 negative.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and high Ki-67, not small mature lymphocytes.

captions: H&E: dense small lymphocytic infiltrate in pericardium (inset: monotonous small lymphocytes)
IHC: diffuse staining of the lymphoid infiltrate
IHC: diffuse staining with a second marker

60527.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色（未標示抗體）中，大量小至中型淋巴細胞呈膜狀與細胞質棕色陽性、瀰漫分布，陰性的細胞則是核較大、卵圓形淡染的類上皮組織球；陽性淋巴細胞佔視野大部分。
features: IHC with brown DAB chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain; antibody not labeled
Diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in numerous small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Some positive cells are slightly enlarged with mildly irregular nuclei
Negative cells have larger oval pale vesicular nuclei with abundant cytoplasm, resembling epithelioid histiocytes
Positive cells form the majority of the cellular population
60527.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in the majority of small-to-medium lymphoid cells, some slightly enlarged with mildly irregular nuclei. Negative cells with larger oval pale nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, consistent with epithelioid histiocytes, are interspersed throughout. The antibody is not labeled, so the lineage marker cannot be named from the image, though the pattern fits a T-cell-associated antigen. In the context of the title, the findings support a T-cell-predominant infiltrate with abundant histiocytes, compatible with lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) lymphoma, a variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells show a mixed CD4/CD8 population with intact pan-T antigens and polyclonal TCR.
AITL neoplastic T cells express TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with CD21+ follicular dendritic meshwork expansion.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains large CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells, which are T-cell marker negative.

60463.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片 BCL2 染色，真皮至皮下脂肪的密集淋巴樣浸潤幾乎全數呈強烈棕色細胞質／膜性陽性，表皮與血管周圍間質陰性；腿型瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤典型為 BCL2 強陽性。
features: Dense dermal and subcutaneous lymphoid infiltrate with strong, diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous BCL2 staining
Positivity in essentially all infiltrating cells in sheets, not confined to scattered small T cells
Infiltrate extends among adipocytes of the subcutis at upper right
Negative vessels, adnexal structures, and collagen stroma interrupting the sheets
Tissue-marking dye (blue-green) at the specimen edges
60463.describe_en: BCL2 immunostain on a skin biopsy shows strong, diffuse cytoplasmic positivity in the dense lymphoid infiltrate occupying the dermis and extending into the subcutaneous fat. Virtually all infiltrating cells stain, whereas vessels, adnexal structures, and stroma are negative. Because reactive T cells also express BCL2, the result should be interpreted together with CD20 staining of the same population. Strong BCL2 expression in a large B-cell infiltrate is consistent with primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.vs: PCFCL is typically BCL2 negative or only weakly positive in neoplastic cells and MUM1 negative.

ddx.dx: Systemic follicular lymphoma or DLBCL involving skin
ddx.vs: Strong BCL2 can be seen in secondary cutaneous involvement, so staging and BCL2 rearrangement studies help distinguish them.

ddx.dx: T-cell-rich cutaneous infiltrate (e.g., mycosis fungoides tumor stage)
ddx.vs: T cells are also BCL2 positive, but they are CD3 positive and CD20 negative.

60271.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結：下方有具生發中心的反應性次級濾泡，中上方大片淡粉紅色、互相連通的組織球區域把深藍色淋巴球分隔成條索狀，淋巴結架構仍保留，呈良性組織球增生（竇組織球增生／副皮質擴張）的圖像。
features: Lymph node with preserved overall architecture and capsule at lower left
Reactive secondary follicle with germinal center and mantle zone at the bottom
Extensive pale eosinophilic zones of histiocytes forming interconnected, serpiginous bands that expand the paracortex/sinus areas
Dark lymphocyte-rich cords compartmentalized between the pale histiocytic areas
No sheets of atypical cells, necrosis or granulomas at this low power
60271.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows preserved architecture with a reactive secondary follicle containing a germinal center at the bottom of the field. The paracortex and sinus regions are extensively expanded by pale eosinophilic aggregates of histiocytes forming interconnected, serpiginous bands that separate cords of small dark lymphocytes. No necrosis, granulomas or sheets of cytologically atypical cells are seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a reactive histiocytic proliferation with sinus histiocytosis and paracortical expansion; in the same node, melanin-laden histiocytes at high power support dermatopathic change.

ddx.vs: Dermatopathic change produces pale paracortical nodules of Langerhans and interdigitating dendritic cells with melanin-laden macrophages, which requires high power (and S100/CD1a) to confirm.
Rosai-Dorfman shows markedly dilated sinuses filled with large S100-positive histiocytes displaying emperipolesis, often with capsular fibrosis and plasma cells.
Metastatic cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and keratin positivity, whereas sinus histiocytes are bland and CD68/CD163-positive.
LCH distends sinuses with Langerhans cells having grooved nuclei and abundant eosinophils and is CD1a/langerin-positive.

60079.recognize_zh: 視野右上方有一個形態正常、多葉核的大型巨核細胞，其餘有核細胞多為各階段顆粒球系與嗜伊紅球；箭頭指的是一顆小型、細胞質深藍、圓核的早期紅血球前驅細胞（嗜鹼性正母紅血球），整片幾乎找不到成熟母紅血球；巨核細胞與顆粒球系保留、只有紅血球系缺乏，符合 Diamond-Blackfan anemia。
features: Marked myeloid predominance with granulocytic precursors at all stages and several eosinophils
Arrow: rare early erythroid precursor with round nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (basophilic normoblast)
Large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and normally lobulated nucleus
Near absence of polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Scattered small lymphocytes; no dysplasia or blast increase; brownish red cell staining artifact
60079.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a marked myeloid predominance, including granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation and several eosinophils. A large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a normally lobulated nucleus is present, indicating preserved megakaryopoiesis. Erythroid precursors are markedly reduced; a rare early erythroid precursor with a round nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm is identified (arrow), with virtually no later-stage normoblasts. Findings are consistent with selective erythroid hypoplasia with preserved granulopoiesis and megakaryopoiesis, supporting Diamond-Blackfan anemia in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Same selective erythroid hypoplasia, but occurs in older children without congenital anomalies, with normal MCV, HbF, and eADA, and resolves spontaneously.
Residual pronormoblasts are giant with intranuclear viral inclusions, and B19 PCR is positive.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia or inherited bone marrow failure
ddx.vs: Involves all three lineages with hypocellularity and reduced megakaryocytes, whereas megakaryocytes and granulocytes are preserved here.
Features vacuolization of erythroid and myeloid precursors, ring sideroblasts, and exocrine pancreatic insufficiency with mitochondrial DNA deletion.

60015.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中母細胞呈兩群（dimorphic）：一群較大、有中量藍色細胞質與不規則折疊核及核仁，另一群較小、細胞質極少、染色質較緻密，類似淋巴母細胞；兩種型態並存提示混合表型急性白血病，需流式與 BCR::ABL1 確認。
features: Dimorphic blast population in a cellular aspirate
Larger blasts: moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm, irregular or folded nuclei, fine chromatin, and visible nucleoli
Smaller blasts: scant cytoplasm, round nuclei with somewhat denser chromatin and indistinct nucleoli (lymphoblast-like)
Occasional maturing granulocyte (band/metamyelocyte) and smudged granular cells
No Auer rods identified
60015.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous blasts with a dimorphic morphology. One population is intermediate to large with moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm, irregular or folded nuclear contours, fine chromatin, and nucleoli; the second is small to intermediate with scant cytoplasm, round nuclei, and inconspicuous nucleoli. Residual granulocytic elements are sparse, and Auer rods are not identified. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with two morphologically distinct blast populations, which in conjunction with flow cytometry and t(9;22) supports mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Ph-positive B-ALL may show variable blast size but lacks a distinct MPO-positive myeloid population; flow cytometry assigning both B and myeloid lineages is decisive.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: CML-BP has a preceding chronic phase history and marrow background of basophilia, dwarf megakaryocytes, and myeloid hyperplasia, whereas de novo MPAL lacks this.
The larger cells with folded nuclei may mimic monocytic blasts, but AMML lacks lymphoid-lineage markers and shows NSE positivity.
AML with maturation shows 10% or more maturing granulocytes and Auer rods without a second lymphoblast-like population.

29999.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中淋巴球明顯增多，許多細胞具有淡藍、邊緣有角的細胞質；高倍下淋巴球細胞質內可見成束、平行的細絲狀條紋（filamentous-like inclusions），核染色質呈塊狀，符合伴特殊細胞質包涵體的慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: Panel A: absolute lymphocytosis with many small to medium lymphocytes and a few neutrophils
Lymphocytes with moderate pale blue cytoplasm and angular or irregular cytoplasmic borders
Panel B: lymphocyte with parallel fine filamentous/fibrillar striations in the cytoplasm
Mature nucleus with clumped chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus
Normocytic red cells with rouleaux-free distribution; smudge cells not prominent in these fields
29999.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa; low and high power) shows an absolute lymphocytosis of small to medium mature-appearing lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and moderate, pale, angular cytoplasm. At high power, the cytoplasm contains parallel, fine filamentous striations. Prolymphocytes and blasts are not prominent in these fields. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with unusual filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, a rare morphologic variant that should be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim surface light chain restriction).

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with a CD11c/CD25/CD103/annexin A1 phenotype, rather than intracytoplasmic parallel filaments.
Villous lymphocytes show short polar cytoplasmic projections and are CD5-negative/CD23-negative on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma / plasma cell with crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Crystal-containing cells show plasmacytoid features with rod-shaped immunoglobulin crystals and an IgM paraprotein, often with MYD88 L265P.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm indenting red cells and lack a clonal CD5+/CD23+ population.

28527.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一個淋巴球含兩個圓形核（雙核淋巴球），骨髓切片的 B 細胞標記顯示陽性細胞沿著竇狀隙呈線狀排列（intrasinusoidal），這兩個線索合起來指向持續性多株 B 細胞淋巴球增多症（PPBL）。
features: Binucleated mature lymphocyte with two round, closely apposed nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm (panel A)
Background red cells and platelets without other atypical cells in the field
Marrow biopsy immunostain showing B cells arranged in linear chains within sinusoids (intrasinusoidal pattern) (panel B; marker likely CD20)
Scattered small interstitial positive cells without nodular aggregates
28527.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature lymphocyte with two round, symmetric nuclei, condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy immunostain highlights B cells arranged predominantly in an intrasinusoidal linear pattern with scattered interstitial cells, without nodular or diffuse infiltrates. In an asymptomatic middle-aged woman with lymphocytosis, binucleated lymphocytes and intrasinusoidal B cells are suggestive of persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis; confirmation with polytypic light chains on flow cytometry, polyclonal IgM elevation, smoking history and i(3q) cytogenetics is recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL also shows intrasinusoidal infiltration but has light-chain-restricted villous lymphocytes and lacks the binucleated cells and polyclonal pattern of PPBL.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia / monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis
ddx.vs: CLL/MBL lymphocytes are small, mononuclear with soccer-ball chromatin and show CD5+/CD23+ light-chain restriction with nodular or interstitial marrow involvement.
Viral lymphocytosis shows large reactive T lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells, not binucleated B cells, and resolves over weeks.
HCL cells have abundant cytoplasm with hairy projections, cytopenias including monocytopenia, and CD103/CD25/annexin A1 expression.

28143.recognize_zh: 病人軀幹與手臂幾乎全身紅皮（erythroderma），側腹有大片鬆弛水泡、表皮剝脫與糜爛面，符合重度（皮膚第 4 期）急性 GVHD，外觀類似毒性表皮壞死溶解症（TEN）。
features: Generalized erythroderma involving the trunk, shoulder and arm with scattered spared paler islands
Large flaccid bullae with serous/yellow fluid over the flank
Areas of epidermal detachment and erosion
Superficial desquamation over the chest and back
Extent of involvement corresponds to skin stage 4 acute GVHD
28143.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lateral trunk and arm shows near-universal erythroderma with small islands of relatively spared skin, large flaccid serous bullae over the flank, and areas of epidermal detachment and erosion. These findings indicate generalized erythroderma with bullous formation and desquamation. In the post-transplant setting, the findings are consistent with severe (skin stage 4) acute graft-versus-host disease; toxic epidermal necrolysis must be considered, and skin biopsy showing full-thickness epidermal necrosis with subepidermal separation supports the grade.

ddx.vs: TEN is linked to a culprit drug with prominent mucosal involvement and targetoid prodromal lesions, but histology of stage 4 GVHD and TEN can be indistinguishable, so clinical context is decisive.
SSSS shows a superficial subcorneal split without keratinocyte necrosis and usually spares mucosae.
Pemphigoid forms tense bullae on urticarial plaques with linear IgG/C3 at the basement membrane on direct immunofluorescence.

24623.recognize_zh: 移植後復發 AML 接受供者淋巴球輸注（DLI）後的骨髓切片，A 圖可見成片小至中型淋巴樣單核細胞浸潤取代造血組織，C、D 圖免疫染色顯示大量陽性的淋巴球（膜性/細胞質強染），代表密集的 T 淋巴球浸潤，符合移植物抗白血病（GVL）反應的影像。
features: Hypercellular marrow largely replaced by a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small to medium mononuclear lymphoid cells
Lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm; no obvious blast sheets
Scattered larger histiocytoid cells within the infiltrate
IHC panel B: membranous positivity in a subset of cells and vessels
IHC panels C and D: strong positivity in the majority of infiltrating lymphocytes, supporting a T-cell-rich infiltrate
Antibody identities are not labeled in the figure
24623.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy after donor lymphocyte infusion shows a hypercellular marrow with a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, replacing normal hematopoiesis. Discrete sheets of myeloblasts are not evident on the morphologic panel. Immunohistochemical stains (antibodies not labeled in the figure) show strong staining of the majority of infiltrating lymphocytes, with a subset of cells showing membranous staining in a separate stain. In the clinical context of remission after DLI, findings are consistent with a donor T-cell-mediated graft-versus-leukemia infiltrate in the marrow; correlation with chimerism studies and exclusion of residual leukemia are required.

ddx.vs: Relapse shows sheets of blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli that are CD34/CD117/MPO positive, whereas this infiltrate is composed of mature-appearing lymphocytes staining with lymphoid markers.
PTLD is usually a B-cell (often EBV-positive, EBER+) proliferation with atypical large cells, while a GVL infiltrate is polyclonal T-cell-rich.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows cytologic atypia, aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, which are not expected in a reactive donor T-cell infiltrate.

13039.recognize_zh: 肉眼看玻片上布滿大小不一的圓形空白斑（左），顯微鏡下紅血球被推擠到大型圓形無細胞空洞的邊緣排成環狀（右），這是 Cremophor（聚氧乙烯蓖麻油）等化學物質造成的抹片人工假象，不是細胞本身的異常。
features: Grossly, the stained blood smear shows multiple round pale clear spots of varying size across the slide (left panel)
Microscopically, large round acellular clear spaces with sharp borders displacing red cells (right panel)
Red cells packed in rings and bands around the edges of the clear spaces
Individual red cells and the occasional leukocyte are morphologically intact
No true cellular abnormality; the pattern reflects droplet interference with smear spreading
13039.describe_en: The gross image of the Wright-stained peripheral blood smear shows numerous round pale spots across the film. Microscopically there are large round acellular spaces with sharp margins, around which red cells are displaced and packed into rings and bands, while the cells themselves appear intact. This pattern represents a smear artifact from a non-miscible substance in the specimen. Findings are consistent with a chemical-associated artifact due to Cremophor EL (polyoxyethylated castor oil) used to solubilize paclitaxel; a sample drawn away from the infusion line should be requested and no morphologic interpretation should be based on the affected areas.

ddx.vs: Water artifact produces refractile, moth-eaten inclusions within individual red cells rather than large round cell-free spaces that push red cells aside.
Lipemia gives a diffusely hazy film and turbid plasma, whereas this artifact forms discrete droplet-like holes associated with drug infusion.
Rouleaux forms stacked coin-like chains and agglutination forms irregular clumps, whereas here red cells are simply displaced around empty circular spaces.

4143.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有三顆中等大小的芽細胞，核質比極高、核圓、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質僅剩一圈薄藍邊且無顆粒，屬淋巴芽細胞（lymphoblast）型態；T 或 B 系別必須靠流式細胞儀（cytoplasmic CD3）才能確定。
features: Medium-sized blasts, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely dispersed to slightly stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Red cells show refractile drying artifact; no platelets clumps or maturing granulocytes in the field
4143.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts of medium size with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a scant rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. No Auer rods are identified. Normal leukocytes and platelets are not evident in this field, and red cells show refractile drying artifact. The blasts have lymphoblastic morphology; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry, and in the stated context findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and are separated by CD19/CD79a/CD22 expression versus cytoplasmic CD3 in T-ALL.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may also be agranular but express CD13/CD33/CD117 and lack lymphoid lineage markers.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse clumped chromatin and no nucleolar detail, and flow lacks TdT and CD34.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and express surface light chain without TdT.

3695.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片左側為密集小淋巴球，右側為大而淡染、有核分裂與凋亡碎屑的反應性生發中心；小淋巴球區內散在小群淡嗜伊紅的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），這是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的典型線索之一。
features: Sharp interface between a zone of small mature lymphocytes (left) and a zone of larger activated cells (right)
Right zone composed of centroblast-like and centrocyte-like cells with vesicular nuclei, mitotic figures and apoptotic debris, consistent with a hyperplastic germinal center
Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei within the lymphoid area
No well-formed granulomas, necrosis or multinucleated giant cells
Scattered small vessels; no organisms identifiable at this magnification
3695.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node shows a hyperplastic germinal center with centroblasts, mitoses and apoptotic debris, sharply demarcated from a surrounding zone of small lymphocytes. Small, poorly formed clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are present within the lymphoid tissue, without necrosis or giant cells. Organisms are not identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis (Piringer-Kuchinka pattern), in which follicular hyperplasia, small epithelioid histiocyte clusters and monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia form the diagnostic triad; confirm with Toxoplasma serology.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back follicles with attenuated mantles, loss of polarization, absent tingible body macrophages and BCL2-positive germinal centers.
These form well-circumscribed granulomas with giant cells and, for mycobacteria, caseating necrosis, rather than small loose epithelioid clusters.
Cat scratch disease shows stellate suppurative necrotizing granulomas with neutrophils, which are absent here.

ddx.dx: Lymphocyte-rich classic Hodgkin lymphoma or NLPHL with epithelioid histiocytes
ddx.vs: These contain CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin cells or CD20-positive LP cells, which are not seen among the histiocyte clusters.

1199.recognize_zh: 普魯士藍鐵染色下，多顆粉紅色核的紅血球前驅細胞周圍有藍綠色鐵顆粒排成環狀或半環狀圍繞細胞核，就是環形鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；另可見巨噬細胞內塊狀藍色儲存鐵。
features: Erythroid precursors (pink counterstained nuclei) with blue-green iron granules arranged in a perinuclear ring or partial ring
Several precursors show five or more granules encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference
Coarse clumped blue iron within scattered macrophages (increased storage iron)
Numerous free blue siderotic granules in the background
Focal crush/overlap and brown pigment limit evaluation in parts of the field
1199.describe_en: Iron-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows abundant storage iron within macrophages and numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring or partial ring. Several precursors meet the criterion of five or more granules encircling at least one-third of the nucleus. Portions of the field are thick, limiting a precise count. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts; quantification (≥15%, or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation) and correlation with Wright-Giemsa dysplasia, SF3B1 status and exclusion of reversible causes (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc excess, isoniazid) are required for MDS with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have a few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.
Has similar ring sideroblasts but presents in young patients with microcytosis and ALAS2 or other germline mutations.

ddx.dx: Secondary sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, drugs)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical ring sideroblasts; history, copper/zinc levels and reversibility distinguish them.
Iron granules overlying or between cells without perinuclear arrangement within an erythroid precursor do not count as ring sideroblasts.

1967.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的兩顆細胞核圓、細胞質內佈滿粗大顆粒，顆粒中夾雜深紫色與橘紅色，屬於嗜酸性球前驅細胞（eosinophilic myelocytes），未成熟的嗜酸性顆粒常帶嗜鹼性色調。
features: Two arrowed medium to large cells with round to oval nuclei and relatively open chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with coarse granules showing mixed dark purple (immature) and orange-red hues
Granules partly overlie the nucleus
Adjacent neutrophilic band and segmented forms, myelocytes and erythroid precursors
Normal-appearing maturing marrow background
1967.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two eosinophilic precursors (arrows) with round nuclei and cytoplasm filled with coarse granules of mixed dark purple-basophilic and orange-red tint, consistent with eosinophilic myelocytes. The background contains maturing neutrophilic and erythroid precursors without an obvious abnormal population. Immature eosinophil granules often stain basophilic, which should not be misinterpreted as basophils or abnormal eosinophils.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are fewer, more variable and deep purple-black, obscuring the nucleus, without the orange-red component.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophils of AML with inv(16)
ddx.vs: Inv(16) eosinophils show large, very dark purple granules in increased numbers accompanied by increased blasts.
Promyelocytes have fine azurophilic purple granules with a perinuclear hof and lack orange-red specific granules.
Mast cells are larger or spindled with dense uniform metachromatic purple-black granules.

1775.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中有一團緊密堆疊、細胞邊界清楚並互相擠壓成多角形（nuclear molding）的細胞團，周圍散布深藍色胞質的單一圓形細胞與多空泡巨噬細胞；在兒童胸水出現這種外來的密集細胞團，應考慮轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of closely packed cells with distinct borders and polygonal molding
Cells in the cluster have round nuclei with pale to smudged chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm
Scattered single round cells at the cluster edge and in the background with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round eccentric nuclei
Vacuolated macrophages admixed around the cluster
Small red cells at low magnification; nuclear detail within the cluster limited by thickness
1775.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows a cohesive three-dimensional cluster of tightly packed cells with nuclear molding and distinct cell borders, together with scattered single round cells with basophilic cytoplasm and vacuolated macrophages. Cytologic detail within the cluster is partly obscured by thickness, and rosettes are not identified. The presence of cohesive clusters of cells foreign to the effusion supports a malignant effusion; in a pediatric patient this is consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma, to be confirmed by immunocytochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, CD56, CD45-negative).

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells are larger with abundant two-tone cytoplasm, intercellular windows and knobby cluster outlines, and are calretinin-positive.
Cells are discohesive and CD45-positive rather than forming molded cohesive clusters.
Similar small round cell clusters; separated by desmin/myogenin or CD99/NKX2-2 and molecular testing.

2607.recognize_zh: 上方中央有一顆巨大的原紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast），細胞質深藍色並有突起（cytoplasmic blebs），核內可見大而暗的類核仁包涵體，是微小病毒 B19（parvovirus B19）感染的典型線索。
features: Giant pronormoblasts, several times the size of surrounding cells
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with irregular cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods
Large round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and large dark nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions
Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors in the background
Background of maturing granulocytic cells, lymphocytes and red cells
2607.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing blunt cytoplasmic blebs. Their large nuclei contain finely dispersed chromatin with prominent, dark, nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions. Maturing erythroid precursors are sparse, while granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes are present in the background. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection with giant pronormoblasts, as seen in pure red cell aplasia or transient aplastic crisis.

ddx.dx: Acute erythroid leukemia / pure erythroid leukemia
ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets with vacuolated cytoplasm and lack viral intranuclear inclusions; parvovirus giant pronormoblasts are scattered in an erythroid-depleted marrow and are B19 immunostain/PCR positive.
Megaloblastic marrow is erythroid hyperplastic with a full spectrum of enlarged maturing precursors and giant metamyelocytes, not isolated giant pronormoblasts in an erythroid-hypoplastic background.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or metastatic tumor cells
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts show platelet-like cytoplasmic budding without intranuclear inclusions and express CD41/CD61, whereas parvovirus-infected cells are erythroid (CD71/E-cadherin positive) with glassy nuclear inclusions.

1263.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜中性球的核完全沒有分葉，呈單一圓到卵圓形、染色質粗塊濃縮，但細胞質已有成熟的淡粉紅顆粒，核質成熟度不相符（非分葉的成熟嗜中性球），是 Pelger-Huët 變異型。
features: Neutrophil-sized cell with a single round to oval, non-lobated nucleus
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin despite lack of segmentation
Abundant pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules and a few small vacuoles
Normal granulation without hypogranularity in this cell
Background red cells with rouleaux-like overlap and scattered platelets
1263.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a single round to oval, non-lobated nucleus containing coarse, clumped mature chromatin. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale with fine neutrophilic granules and a few small vacuoles. The combination of fully mature chromatin with absence of lobation distinguishes this cell from a myelocyte. The appearance represents a non-segmented Pelger-Huët-type neutrophil; the inherited anomaly is diagnosed when most neutrophils are hyposegmented with normal granulation, while an acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change should raise concern for myelodysplasia or drug effect.

ddx.vs: Myelocytes have finer, less condensed chromatin and often a paler Golgi zone, while this cell has fully clumped mature chromatin.

Morphology of a single cell is similar; acquired forms show hypogranularity, other dysplastic lineages and involve only a subset of neutrophils, whereas the inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, not coarse condensed chromatin.
Lymphocytes have scant basophilic cytoplasm without neutrophilic granules.

1071.recognize_zh: 中央的分節中性球細胞質佈滿粗大紫紅色毒性顆粒，細胞質右下緣有一塊淡藍色、邊界不清的斑塊，即 Döhle 小體。
features: Segmented neutrophil with coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules (toxic granulation)
Pale blue, irregular peripheral cytoplasmic inclusion at the lower right margin (Döhle body)
Nuclear lobes with condensed chromatin
Background echinocytes/crenated red cells and a polychromatophilic red cell
1071.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high magnification shows a segmented neutrophil with coarse, dark cytoplasmic granulation and a pale blue, ill-defined inclusion at the periphery of the cytoplasm, consistent with a Döhle body. Background red cells include occasional crenated cells and a polychromatophilic cell. Findings are consistent with toxic changes in neutrophils (toxic granulation and Döhle bodies), as seen in sepsis, inflammation, burns, pregnancy or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, spindle-shaped and more sharply outlined, present in most neutrophils without toxic granulation, with giant platelets.
Morulae are dark purple, stippled, berry-like clusters within neutrophil cytoplasm rather than a pale blue homogeneous patch.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark granules in all leukocyte types and are not accompanied by Döhle bodies.

1135.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片網狀纖維染色（銀染色），骨小梁染成棕金色，骨髓間隙內可見黑色細網狀纖維，大多稀疏、少有交錯，屬於正常或輕度（約MF-0至MF-1）程度。
features: Bony trabeculae stained golden-brown with silver impregnation
Thin black reticulin fibers forming a loose, focally intersecting network in the intertrabecular spaces
Fibers accentuated around vessels and near trabeculae without dense bundles
Fatty areas on the left and a more cellular area on the right
No thick coarse fibers or collagen bundles evident
1135.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section stained for reticulin shows golden-brown bony trabeculae with adjacent fatty and more cellular marrow spaces. Thin black reticulin fibers form a loose network with only focal intersections, mainly around vessels and near trabeculae. No dense meshwork or thick collagenous bundles are identified at this magnification. Findings correspond to no or minimal reticulin fibrosis (approximately MF-0 to MF-1); higher-power assessment across the core is needed for formal grading.

ddx.vs: Higher grades show a diffuse dense network with extensive intersections and focal thick bundles (MF-2) or collagen with osteosclerosis (MF-3).
Collagen fibers are thick and stain blue on trichrome, whereas reticulin fibers are fine black argyrophilic threads.
Normal marrow shows fibers only around vessels and trabeculae without intersecting networks in the interstitium.

4207.recognize_zh: 脾臟免疫染色中紅髓充滿大量陽性的中小型淋巴球，呈瀰漫分布，只有少數淡染的區塊（可能是白髓）為陰性，提示紅髓內以某一T細胞族群擴張為主；抗體名稱未標示。
features: Diffuse dense positivity in numerous small to medium lymphoid cells throughout the red pulp
Membranous/cytoplasmic ring-like staining pattern of individual cells
Scattered pale negative zones, likely white pulp or vascular spaces
No discrete positive nodules; distribution is diffuse and interstitial
Specific antibody not labeled
4207.describe_en: Immunostained splenic section at medium power shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with membranous staining throughout the red pulp, sparing scattered pale zones that likely represent white pulp. The pattern suggests expansion of a T-cell population (e.g., CD3 or CD8), although the antibody is not labeled. In the context of infectious mononucleosis, this would be consistent with the reactive cytotoxic T-cell expansion that infiltrates the red pulp and predisposes to rupture.

ddx.vs: HSTL shows monotonous medium-sized T-cells within sinusoids, typically CD8-negative gamma-delta T-cells with isochromosome 7q, rather than a polymorphous reactive infiltrate.
T-LGL shows a clonal CD8+/CD57+ population with cytopenias and persistent blood lymphocytosis, confirmed by TCR clonality and STAT3 mutation.

4015.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成片的中大型細胞緊密聚集，核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少，且彼此核互相擠壓（nuclear molding）；外觀易被誤認為母細胞或淋巴瘤，但成團黏聚與核擠壓指向小細胞神經內分泌癌轉移。
features: Cohesive sheets and clusters of medium to large cells with high N:C ratio
Finely granular, salt-and-pepper-like chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Nuclear molding between adjacent tumor cells
Scant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Few residual hematopoietic cells and red cells at the periphery
4015.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cohesive sheets of medium to large cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Nuclear molding is evident between adjacent cells, and normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Although these cells may mimic lymphoma or leukemic blasts, their cohesive growth favors a non-hematopoietic neoplasm. Findings are suggestive of metastatic small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma; confirmation by biopsy immunohistochemistry (keratin, synaptophysin, chromogranin, INSM1, TTF-1; CD45 negative) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are discohesive and lack nuclear molding; clumping in thick smear areas can mimic cohesion, so CD45 and lineage markers are decisive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell or Burkitt lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive with basophilic cytoplasm and lymphoglandular bodies, and are CD45 and CD20 positive.
These small round cell tumors occur mainly in children and require CD99, NKX2.2, PHOX2B or genetic studies to separate from small-cell carcinoma.
Merkel cell carcinoma is morphologically similar but shows perinuclear dot CK20 and Merkel cell polyomavirus, and is usually TTF-1 negative.

3887.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的紅血球在細胞邊緣有一小簇深藍紫色的細小顆粒，顆粒聚成一團而非平均撒在整個細胞，這就是 Pappenheimer bodies；確認需用 Prussian blue 染出含鐵成分。
features: Red cells with small clusters of fine dark basophilic granules at the cell periphery (arrows)
Granules grouped in one or two aggregates rather than diffusely distributed
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional crenated/echinocytic cells
Single small lymphocyte; background refractile drying artifacts
3887.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several red cells containing small peripheral clusters of fine basophilic granules (arrows), consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. The granules are grouped rather than evenly scattered through the cell, which separates them from basophilic stippling. The remaining red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional crenated cells, and a small lymphocyte is present. Findings are consistent with Pappenheimer bodies; a Prussian blue stain would confirm siderotic granules, and asplenia, sideroblastic anemia or hemolytic anemia should be considered.

ddx.vs: Stippling is diffuse throughout the red cell and iron-negative, while Pappenheimer bodies are peripheral clustered granules that stain with Prussian blue.
A Howell-Jolly body is usually a single, larger, round, dense DNA remnant rather than a cluster of tiny granules.
Heinz bodies are not visible on Wright stain and require supravital stains such as crystal violet, where they appear as larger membrane-attached inclusions.

3823.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片中紅髓內大量淡染、細胞質呈細泡沫狀的大型組織球成群或成片分布，夾雜小淋巴球與紅血球，是 Niemann-Pick 病的脾臟泡沫細胞浸潤。
features: Sheets and clusters of large histiocytes with pale, finely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm
Small, round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei in storage cells
Foamy cells expanding red pulp cords, admixed with red cells
Scattered small lymphocytes and a small vessel/trabecular element
No atypical lymphoid infiltrate or necrosis
3823.describe_en: Section of spleen shows expansion of the red pulp by numerous clusters and sheets of large histiocytes with pale, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and small bland nuclei, admixed with red cells and scattered small lymphocytes. No atypical lymphoid infiltrate, granulomas, or necrosis are identified. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by a lipid storage disorder, compatible with Niemann-Pick disease in the clinical context.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have eosinophilic, fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clear bubbly vacuoles.
HCL shows red pulp infiltration by small lymphoid cells with fried-egg clear cytoplasm and blood lakes, and is CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive rather than CD68 positive.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial or Whipple infection with foamy macrophages
ddx.vs: Infectious foamy macrophages are AFB or PAS-diastase positive for organisms.

ddx.dx: Ceroid histiocytosis/sea-blue histiocytosis secondary to ITP or hyperlipidemia
ddx.vs: Secondary lipid histiocytes are usually focal and fewer, without diffuse replacement, and enzyme testing is normal.

3759.recognize_zh: 高倍可見多顆帶狀或分葉少的嗜中性球，部分細胞質有粗大毒性顆粒，另有兩個星芒狀、中央紫色顆粒、周邊淡藍並有小空泡的大團塊，疑為大型血小板或血小板聚集，符合 G-CSF 反應。
features: Several band and hyposegmented neutrophils; lower-left cells show coarse dark toxic granulation
Upper neutrophils have paler, less granular cytoplasm
Two large irregular stellate bodies with central purple granular material, pale blue periphery and small vacuoles, favored giant platelets or platelet aggregates
No nucleus identified within the stellate bodies
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
3759.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased neutrophils, predominantly band and hyposegmented forms, several with coarse toxic granulation. Two large, irregular, stellate anucleate bodies with central purple granules and a pale vacuolated periphery are present, favored to represent giant platelets or small platelet clumps. Red cells are unremarkable. In a patient receiving growth factor, findings are consistent with G-CSF effect with toxic granulation and left shift.

ddx.vs: Neutrophil changes are identical, so clinical history of G-CSF versus infection distinguishes them.
Micromegakaryocytes contain a dense hypolobated nucleus, which is not seen in these anucleate stellate bodies.
Dysplastic hypolobated neutrophils are typically hypogranular with clumped chromatin, rather than showing coarse toxic granules.

3567.recognize_zh: 中性球細胞質邊緣有一小塊淡藍色、邊界清楚的包涵體（箭頭處，類似 Döhle body），旁邊可見體積偏大的血小板；包涵體加上巨大血小板是 May-Hegglin 異常（MYH9 相關疾病）的典型組合。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a discrete pale-blue, spindle/oval cytoplasmic inclusion near the cell membrane (arrow)
Inclusion is larger and more sharply defined than a typical reactive Döhle body
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal, without toxic granulation or vacuoles
Enlarged platelets adjacent to the neutrophil
RBCs normochromic, normocytic
3567.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a well-demarcated pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusion at the periphery of the cell (arrow). The neutrophil otherwise shows normal granulation without toxic changes. Large platelets are present nearby, and the red cells are unremarkable. In the setting of thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder).

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies are smaller and fainter, and they come with toxic granulation or vacuolization without giant platelets.
Also has giant platelets with thrombocytopenia, but neutrophils lack inclusions and platelets do not agglutinate with ristocetin.
Inclusions are giant peroxidase-positive azurophilic/grey granules rather than pale-blue non-granular inclusions, and platelets are not giant.
Neutrophils lack cytoplasmic inclusions, and NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence shows normal diffuse staining.

3311.recognize_zh: 五顆原始淋巴細胞聚在一起，細胞核圓、染色質細緻均勻略呈點狀，核仁不明顯，細胞質只剩極薄的一圈淡藍色邊緣、沒有顆粒；高核質比、細緻染色質且無顆粒是 B-ALL 原始細胞的典型形態。
features: Cluster of five blasts roughly 1.5-2 times the size of red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round, smooth nuclear contours
Finely dispersed, slightly stippled chromatin with faint small nucleoli
No Auer rods, granules or cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background normocytic red cells
3311.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of five blasts in a background of normocytic red cells. The blasts are intermediate in size, with very high N:C ratios, round smooth nuclei, finely dispersed slightly stippled chromatin, faint small nucleoli and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods, granules or cytoplasmic vacuoles are identified. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, in context precursor B-cell type; lineage must be confirmed by flow cytometry, and cytogenetic studies are needed for risk stratification.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm, visible nucleoli and may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods, with MPO positivity.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent vacuoles and mature B-cell immunophenotype lacking TdT.
Morphology is identical; cytoplasmic CD3 positivity defines T lineage.
Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1-positive with surface light chain restriction.

3375.recognize_zh: 高倍下骨髓間質被波浪狀、流線排列的粉紅色纖維與梭形細胞取代，其間散布許多含金褐色含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）顆粒的巨噬細胞，符合骨髓纖維化。
features: Streaming, wavy eosinophilic fibrillary stroma replacing hematopoietic tissue
Scattered spindle-shaped fibroblast-like nuclei aligned with the fibers
Numerous macrophages laden with coarse golden-brown (hemosiderin) pigment
Few residual hematopoietic cells, including plasma cells and lymphocytes at upper right
No atypical megakaryocytes or cohesive tumor clusters in this field
3375.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows the marrow space replaced by streaming, wavy fibrillary stroma with scattered spindled stromal cells. Numerous macrophages containing coarse golden-brown pigment, consistent with hemosiderin, are distributed along the fibers, and only a few residual hematopoietic and lymphoplasmacytic cells are present. No megakaryocytic atypia or infiltrating tumor cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow fibrosis with prominent hemosiderin deposition; iron and reticulin/trichrome stains and clinical correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei within the fibrosis, which are not evident here.
Mastocytosis shows fibrotic aggregates of spindled mast cells that are tryptase/CD117/CD25-positive, often with eosinophils, rather than pigment-laden macrophages.
Melanoma pigment is finer and lies within atypical tumor cells with prominent nucleoli (S100/SOX10+), and Prussian blue is negative, unlike hemosiderin.
Gelatinous transformation shows amorphous pale extracellular ground substance rather than fibrillary collagen with spindle cells.

3247.recognize_zh: 一顆巨噬細胞內塞滿十多個大小一致、橢圓形的小酵母菌（約 2–4 µm），每個周圍有透亮暈圈（pseudocapsule），菌體內可見偏心的點狀或新月形染色質，典型的莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Macrophage with eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm packed with numerous intracellular yeast forms
Uniform small oval yeasts (about 2-4 um) surrounded by a clear halo (pseudocapsule)
Eccentric dot- or crescent-shaped purple chromatin within each yeast
Some yeasts pushed against and indenting the macrophage nucleus
No budding hyphae or large capsules seen
3247.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous uniform, small oval yeast forms, each with a clear surrounding halo and an eccentric dot- or crescent-shaped chromatin body. The organisms crowd against and indent the macrophage nucleus. No hyphae or large mucoid capsules are identified. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection; confirmation by GMS stain, urine/serum antigen testing, or culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack the clear halo seen around Histoplasma yeasts.
Talaromyces yeasts are slightly elongated and divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Candida glabrata is similar in size but is typically extracellular or less densely intracellular and shows no pseudocapsular halo on Wright stain; culture separates them.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and no halo.

3183.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個大型組織球，胞質被無數大小一致的淡藍色小空泡填滿，呈泡沫（肥皂泡）狀，並夾雜幾顆深藍色顆粒，符合Niemann-Pick儲積細胞；周圍邊緣可見APL的顆粒性異常細胞。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm filled by numerous uniform small clear vacuoles, giving a foamy 'soap-bubble' appearance
Pale blue cytoplasmic background with scattered dark blue granules or inclusions
Histiocyte nucleus not clearly visible; an overlying or engulfed cell with a folded nucleus at the upper edge
Adjacent large granular abnormal promyelocytes at the periphery of the field
Background red cells and granular debris
3183.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a large storage histiocyte whose cytoplasm is filled with innumerable uniform small vacuoles, producing a foamy appearance, with a few scattered dark blue granules. Partially visible at the edges of the field are large cells with granular cytoplasm consistent with the abnormal promyelocytes of the concurrent APL. Findings are consistent with a Niemann-Pick-type foamy storage cell; lipid storage disease should be confirmed by enzyme assay (acid sphingomyelinase) or genetic testing.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillar 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm with an eccentric nucleus rather than uniform round foamy vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain coarse blue-green granules rather than predominantly clear vacuoles, although both may coexist in Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.dx: Lipid-laden macrophage from marrow injury or hyperlipidemia
ddx.vs: Reactive foamy macrophages are usually scattered and nonspecific, and a storage disorder requires enzymatic or genetic confirmation rather than morphology alone.

3119.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多顆異常嗜酸性球，胞質內混有粗大深紫色（嗜鹼性）顆粒與橘紅色顆粒，並伴隨核摺疊的單核球系細胞，是AML伴inv(16)／CBFB::MYH11的典型表現。
features: Abnormal eosinophils with large, dark purple-violet basophilic-staining granules admixed with orange eosinophilic granules
Immature monocytic cells with folded or indented nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli
Some cells with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Cellular aspirate with mixed myelomonocytic population
3119.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular mixed population of myeloblasts, immature monocytic cells with folded nuclei, and increased eosinophils. Many eosinophils are abnormal, containing large dark purple-violet granules intermixed with typical orange granules. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, characteristic of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB::MYH11, which should be confirmed by cytogenetics, FISH, or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, and cytogenetic or molecular testing for CBFB::MYH11 is required; abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules strongly favor inv(16).
CMML has fewer than 20% blasts and promonocytes and lacks the dysplastic basophilic-granule eosinophils of inv(16).

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: These show mature-appearing eosinophilia with PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, or JAK2 rearrangements rather than CBFB::MYH11.

2799.recognize_zh: 單顆大型單核球系細胞，核呈不規則分葉/折疊、染色質細緻如花邊，細胞質豐富灰藍色，為異常單核球或前單核球（promonocyte），在 CMML 周邊血可見。
features: Large mononuclear cell, much larger than surrounding red cells
Irregular, lobulated to folded nucleus
Fine, lacy chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm without vacuoles or visible granules
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis (occasional elongated forms)
2799.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large monocytic cell with an irregular, lobulated nucleus, fine lacy chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. Nucleoli are inconspicuous and cytoplasmic vacuoles are not seen. The delicate chromatin and nuclear folding raise the question of an immature monocyte versus a promonocyte, a distinction that matters because promonocytes count as blast equivalents. In the setting of persistent absolute monocytosis, findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are mature with condensed chromatin and are not accompanied by dysplasia, clonal mutations (TET2, SRSF2, ASXL1) or abnormal CD14+/CD16- monocyte partitioning.
Acute monocytic leukemia requires >=20% monoblasts plus promonocytes in blood or marrow, rather than predominantly mature and abnormal monocytes.
Reactive lymphocytes have deeper basophilic cytoplasm scalloped around red cells and a round nucleus with coarser chromatin.
Myelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with coarser chromatin and pinkish secondary granules, while monocytes are MPO weak and NSE positive.

2671.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆嗜中性球，細胞核只分成兩個圓形葉、中間以細絲相連，呈「夾鼻眼鏡」（pince-nez）樣，染色質粗糙團塊狀，符合假性Pelger-Huët細胞。
features: Mature neutrophil of normal size with a bilobed nucleus
Two round, symmetric lobes joined by a thin chromatin bridge (pince-nez configuration)
Coarse, markedly clumped mature chromatin
Pale cytoplasm with fine, relatively sparse granules
Background red cells show overlapping and mild anisocytosis; no other leukocytes in the field
2671.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes connected by a thin filament, in a pince-nez configuration, with coarsely clumped chromatin. The cytoplasm contains fine granules that appear somewhat sparse. Only a single neutrophil is present in the field, so the frequency of hypolobation and the presence of other dysplastic changes cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huët (acquired hypolobated) neutrophil; correlation with medications, infection, and evaluation for myelodysplasia is recommended.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset and often accompany hypogranulation or other dysplasia.
A band has a continuous curved, U- or C-shaped nucleus of uniform width without a thin filament separating discrete round lobes.
MDS is favored when pseudo-Pelger cells are numerous and accompanied by hypogranulation, cytopenias, and multilineage dysplasia, rather than a transient drug- or infection-related change.

2479.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液中並排四個骨髓單核球系細胞：核摺疊或分葉不規則、胞質灰藍，其中一個有空泡、右下一個胞質有粒狀顆粒像未成熟顆粒球；血液中出現異常單核球與未成熟骨髓細胞，符合 JMML。
features: Four medium-sized myelomonocytic cells with grey-blue cytoplasm
Irregular, folded to lobulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin (monocytes/abnormal monocytoid cells)
Small cytoplasmic vacuole in the left cell
Lower right cell with azurophilic granules and a lobulated nucleus, suggesting an immature granulocyte
Background red cells with anisocytosis; no Auer rods
2479.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a cluster of myelomonocytic cells with folded to lobulated nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm, one containing a small vacuole, and an adjacent cell with azurophilic granules suggestive of an immature granulocyte. No Auer rods are present. Red cells show anisocytosis. The presence of atypical monocytes with circulating immature myeloid cells is consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate pediatric clinical and genetic context.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are mature with normal nuclear folding and are not accompanied by immature granulocytes and nucleated red cells.
CML shows predominantly myelocytes and segmented neutrophils with basophilia rather than monocytes and is BCR-ABL1 positive.
AMML shows >=20% blasts and promonocytes with fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than mostly mature-appearing monocytes.

2415.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見摺疊、腎形核的芽細胞與大量帶鮮紅顆粒的嗜酸性系細胞混雜，部分嗜酸性細胞核仍不成熟；芽細胞與嗜酸球增生並存提示 AML with inv(16)。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of blasts and promonocyte-like cells
Oval, folded and kidney-shaped nuclei with fine vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Many eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes with bright red granular cytoplasm, some with immature round nuclei
Scattered small dense erythroid precursors
Abnormal basophilic eosinophil granules cannot be resolved on H&E
2415.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) at high power shows sheets of blasts and monocytoid cells with oval to folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli, admixed with abundant eosinophils and eosinophil precursors with brightly eosinophilic granular cytoplasm. Scattered erythroid precursors are present, and normal maturing hematopoiesis is diminished. The characteristic basophilic granules of abnormal eosinophils cannot be assessed on H&E and require aspirate review. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with increased eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)/CBFB::MYH11.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophilia shows increased mature eosinophils in a normally maturing marrow without sheets of blasts.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Mastocytosis shows spindle mast cell aggregates with fibrosis that are CD117/tryptase positive, often with eosinophils at the periphery.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin or T-cell lymphoma involving marrow with eosinophilia
ddx.vs: Lymphoma infiltrates contain Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells or atypical lymphocytes with fibrosis, rather than MPO/CD34/CD117 positive blasts.

2223.recognize_zh: 視野中以早幼粒、骨髓球、後骨髓球等各階段顆粒球為主，並可見環狀核（ring nucleus）及分葉異常、顆粒偏少的嗜中性球，嗜酸與嗜鹼性球不多，符合 aCML 的顆粒球發育不良。
features: Marked granulocytic predominance with left-shifted maturation (promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Dysgranulopoiesis: ring-shaped nucleus and abnormally segmented neutrophil nuclei
Hypogranular to unevenly granulated cytoplasm in maturing neutrophils
Blasts not increased in this field
No conspicuous basophilia or eosinophilia; scattered erythroid precursors
2223.describe_en: Aspirate smear (likely bone marrow) shows a markedly granulocytic cell population with all stages of maturation, predominantly promyelocytes, myelocytes and metamyelocytes. Dysgranulopoietic features are evident, including a neutrophil with a ring-shaped nucleus, abnormal nuclear segmentation, and hypogranular cytoplasm in several maturing cells. Blasts are not increased in this field, and basophils and monocytes are not prominent. In the setting of BCR-ABL1-negative neutrophilic leukocytosis with circulating immature granulocytes, findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: CML shows prominent basophilia and eosinophilia with little dysgranulopoiesis and requires BCR-ABL1 demonstration.
CNL shows mature segmented neutrophils with toxic granulation, <10% immature granulocytes, no significant dysplasia, and CSF3R mutation.
CMML requires persistent monocytosis (≥1×10⁹/L and ≥10% monocytes), whereas monocytes are not prominent here.
Reactive granulocytosis shows toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without ring nuclei, hypogranularity or clonal abnormalities.

2159.recognize_zh: 中倍抹片下大量芽細胞取代骨髓：細胞大小相近、核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少而嗜鹼性，只零星看到幾個分葉嗜中性球與小淋巴球，缺乏成熟中的顆粒球系細胞，符合 AML without maturation。
features: Marked predominance of blasts replacing normal marrow elements
Medium to large blasts with round to oval nuclei and fine chromatin
High N:C ratio with scant basophilic, mostly agranular cytoplasm
Only rare segmented neutrophils and small lymphocytes; maturing myeloid precursors virtually absent
Few erythroid precursors; scattered fat vacuoles in background
2159.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at medium power shows marked replacement by a relatively uniform population of blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, high N:C ratio, and scant basophilic, largely agranular cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytic precursors are scarce, with only rare segmented neutrophils, small lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors. Auer rods are not evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation, pending cytochemistry (MPO ≥3% of blasts) and flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap; ALL blasts are MPO-negative and express B- or T-lymphoid markers on flow cytometry.
Would show ≥10% promyelocytes, myelocytes, and neutrophils, whereas maturing granulocytic cells are sparse here.
Indistinguishable on Wright stain; it requires <3% MPO/SBB-positive blasts with myeloid antigens by flow.
Erythroid blasts have deeply basophilic, often vacuolated cytoplasm and are E-cadherin/CD71 positive and MPO negative.

2095.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大型母細胞為主，核染色質細緻、核仁可見、細胞質淡藍（箭頭指一顆典型的 myeloblast），同時仍可見帶顆粒的前骨髓細胞與成熟嗜中性球，代表母細胞增生合併部分成熟，符合 AML with maturation。
features: Predominance of large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale to basophilic cytoplasm; occasional fine azurophilic granules
Arrow marks a large myeloblast with a round nucleus and a thin rim of grayish-blue cytoplasm
Maturing granulocytic cells present, including a granulated promyelocyte and segmented neutrophils
No definite Auer rods identified in this field
2095.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and dominated by large blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with sparse azurophilic granules (arrow indicates a representative myeloblast). Maturing granulocytic elements, including promyelocytes and segmented neutrophils, are also present. Auer rods are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, provided blasts are at least 20% with at least 10% maturing granulocytic cells and monocytic cells are under 20%.

ddx.vs: AML without maturation has fewer than 10% maturing granulocytic cells, whereas this field still shows promyelocytes and neutrophils.
It often shows long slender Auer rods, salmon-colored cytoplasm, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and CD19/PAX5 expression, requiring cytogenetics or molecular testing to separate.
It has at least 20% monocytic cells with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase positivity, which are not evident here.
Lymphoblasts lack granules and Auer rods and are MPO negative, whereas myeloblasts with accompanying granulocytic maturation are MPO positive.

2031.recognize_zh: EBV 潛伏膜蛋白（LMP1）免疫染色：在大量藍色、未染色的淋巴球與較大細胞之間，只有少數散在細胞的細胞質／細胞膜呈深棕色陽性，代表部分細胞帶有 EBV，支持 EBV 相關的 PTLD。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for EBV latent membrane protein 1 (LMP1) with hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered cells with strong brown cytoplasmic/membranous staining
Positive cells vary in size, including a larger elongated cell and small round cells
Majority of small lymphoid cells and larger vesicular cells are negative
Loose, partly edematous background in the upper field
2031.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for EBV LMP1 shows scattered cells with strong cytoplasmic and membranous staining, including a larger elongated cell and several smaller round cells, among a predominantly negative population of small lymphoid cells and larger vesicular cells. Only a minority of cells are positive in this field. Findings indicate the presence of EBV-infected cells and support an EBV-associated post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder; EBER in situ hybridization is more sensitive for quantifying EBV-positive cells.

ddx.vs: EBV-negative PTLD typically occurs late after transplant and lacks LMP1/EBER-positive cells, whereas positive cells are present here.

ddx.dx: Scattered EBV-positive bystander B cells in reactive tissue
ddx.vs: Rare EBER-positive cells can be seen in reactive nodes of healthy carriers, so the diagnosis depends on architectural effacement and a significant positive population rather than any positivity.
LMP1 highlights large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells that are CD30+ and CD15+ in cHL-type PTLD, rather than variably sized plasmacytoid cells.

1839.recognize_zh: 一團大小相當一致的小到中型芽細胞，核圓或略有凹陷、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，細胞質極少且無顆粒，符合淋巴芽細胞（lymphoblast）的樣貌。
features: Monotonous small to intermediate blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times the size of an erythrocyte
Very high N:C ratio with scant, agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented or irregular nuclear contours
Finely dispersed, homogeneous chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; cohesive-appearing cluster from a smear
1839.describe_en: Smear shows clusters of monotonous small to intermediate-sized blasts with a very high N:C ratio and scant agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to slightly indented with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods or granules are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; B-lineage assignment (e.g., CD19, CD10, CD79a, TdT) requires flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; separation requires immunophenotyping (cytoplasmic CD3 versus CD19/CD79a).
Blasts may look identical but are MPO-negative by cytochemistry and express CD13/CD33/CD117 with MPO by flow rather than B-lineage markers.
Cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharp lipid vacuoles and coarser chromatin, and are TdT-negative with surface light chain and MYC rearrangement.
Show a spectrum of maturation with smoother, more condensed chromatin and a normal maturation pattern by flow, and do not form monotonous sheets.

1711.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量高，以各階段顆粒球（骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核）為主，夾雜數個較大的前骨髓細胞/母細胞與深染的紅血球前驅細胞，呈現「左移但有秩序成熟」的再生型造血，符合化療後恢復期骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors at all stages (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Scattered larger promyelocytes/early precursors with fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with small round, dense nuclei present in clusters
Orderly maturation without a monotonous blast population
Background with small vacuoles/fat droplets and brownish stain precipitate
1711.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows active trilineage-type regeneration, predominantly granulocytic. There is a left-shifted but orderly maturing myeloid series with numerous myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands, and scattered larger promyelocytes and early precursors. Erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei are present. A monotonous sheet of blasts, Auer rods or overt dysplasia is not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a regenerating marrow following cytotoxic chemotherapy; correlation with a blast count and flow cytometry is needed to exclude residual leukemia.

ddx.vs: Relapse shows a monotonous population of blasts with arrested maturation, whereas this field shows a full spectrum of maturing granulocytes.
Growth-factor effect produces a similar left shift, often with toxic granulation and a promyelocyte-rich marrow, and is separated mainly by clinical history.
MDS shows dysplastic granulocytes (hypogranularity, pseudo-Pelger nuclei) and dyserythropoiesis, which are not evident here.

1519.recognize_zh: 周邊血中多顆中小型淋巴球，細胞質深藍、核形不規則；箭頭所指細胞核有明顯凹陷／皺褶，右上細胞可見單一核仁，符合 T 細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）的核不規則型態。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amount of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Irregular nuclear contours with notches and indentations (arrow)
Moderately condensed chromatin; a single visible nucleolus in some cells (upper right)
Moderate N:C ratio, higher than in typical small mature lymphocytes
A larger cell with pale gray cytoplasm and folded nucleus at lower right, likely a monocyte
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking; rare platelet
1519.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderately abundant, deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are irregular with notches and indentations (arrow), chromatin is moderately condensed, and a single nucleolus is visible in some cells. A cell with pale gray cytoplasm and a folded nucleus, likely a monocyte, is also present. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (irregular-nucleus variant), to be confirmed by flow cytometry and TCL1A/inv(14) studies.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with scant pale cytoplasm and lack prominent nucleoli; clinical erythroderma and CD26 loss support Sezary.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
